AI Create already has typed clarification rounds and should align with the shared interaction behavior.

Added a field_removal recovery type that emits JSON merge-patch null, validates that users cannot substitute another value, and renders a high-confidence schema-safe repair card. Legacy mesher editor schemas now omit target_surface_node_count unless use_inhouse_mesher or use_geometry_AI is active. Plan UI distinguishes repairs from engineering inputs and handles mixed recovery forms. Installed Flow360 25.10 smoke reproduces the original error and proves the removal revalidates successfully. Derive selectable values from the Flow360/flow360-schema unit registry or validated model serialization, keep friendly labels separate from submitted values, and never render recognized unit fields as free text.
acceptance_criteria: Length and all other recognized quantity selectors submit exact tokens accepted by the installed Flow360 version; labels may be human-friendly but wire values are canonical; invalid/free-text unit entry is impossible; existing values normalize safely; real Flow360 model validation plus Go/React tests and production build pass.

The active {value,units} serializer emits str(unyt_value.units.expr), producing m, m/s, m**2, Pa, K, etc.; PhysicalDimensionMeta.si_unit long names are dimension identifiers, not canonical wire tokens. Editor schemas now canonicalize every compatible unit with the same unyt expression rule, expose controlled selectors only, and carry narrow aliases for legacy long-name values. Server validation requires units, accepts only declared options/aliases, and expansion writes canonical tokens. UI normalizes declared legacy values, blocks unknown stored units, and never provides free-text unit entry. Verified installed-schema smoke, all Go tests, race, vet, 243 React tests, TypeScript/Vite build, and make build.
close_reason: Dynamic forms now submit only canonical Flow360 unit tokens and reject uncontrolled unit strings.

title: Replace AI Create STL pseudo-geometry with CAD-safe asset workflow
description: AI Create currently generates cylinder.stl and uploads it as Flow360 geometry. STL is a tessellated surface representation, while this repository and Flow360 Geometry workflow accept CAD/B-rep inputs such as STEP, IGES, BREP, CAX, and CATIA. Real mesh logs show 'Not supported geometry type: cylinder.stl'. Correct the asset semantics and strengthen the AI Create instructions/capability gate.
design: Do not convert tessellated STL into a STEP wrapper and call it CAD. Geometry generation must preserve analytic surfaces/topology through a CAD kernel and undergo local parse/shape validation. A tessellated asset may only enter as surface-mesh when it satisfies that workflow's requirements. Missing CAD-generation capability is a request-missing-input state, not permission to fabricate geometry.
acceptance_criteria: AI Create never uploads STL/OBJ as source_type geometry; generated primitive geometry is emitted as an analytically exact CAD/B-rep file produced and validated by an approved CAD kernel, or the Agent requests a supported CAD upload when that capability is unavailable; blueprint records representation, format, generator, validation and provenance; prompt distinguishes CAD geometry, surface mesh and volume mesh and does not claim unsupported generation; backend rejects incompatible extension/source combinations before Flow360 submission; tests reproduce cylinder.stl rejection and cover the corrected route; full tests/build pass.
notes: Confirmed root cause from real Flow360 logs: cylinder.stl was accepted into a Project but rejected downstream as 'Not supported geometry type'. Replaced the STL triangulation generator with an embedded analytic OpenCascade BREP generated by CadQuery 2.6.1 / OCCT 7.8.1. Independently read back and validated: valid shape, exactly 1 solid, 3 analytic faces, volume pi/4, Triangulations 0. Blueprint now records representation/format/generator/version/validation provenance and template version v2. Explicit non-template diameter/radius/span values are rejected with a STEP/IGES/BREP request. AI system prompt now distinguishes CAD/B-rep Geometry from STL/OBJ tessellations and forbids renamed/wrapped mesh pseudo-CAD. Backend checks allowed Geometry extensions and BREP content before Flow360 submission; tests reject STL and renamed STL. Verified go test ./..., 242 Vitest tests, TypeScript/Vite build, make build, git diff check, and reproducible CadQuery validation script.
close_reason: AI Create now uses a CAD-kernel-generated validated analytic BREP instead of STL pseudo-geometry, enforces representation/source compatibility, and explicitly requests supported CAD outside the audited template.

title: Render Flow360 units as dimension-aware selectors
description: Schema-driven Plan forms currently render units as free text and can default a velocity quantity to meter. Derive allowed units from Flow360 quantity schemas and render controlled selectors so users cannot enter invalid or dimensionally incorrect units.
acceptance_criteria: Quantity units render as selectors; length and velocity expose dimensionally correct options and defaults; free-text units are eliminated from Plan schema forms; sparse serialization remains valid; tests, production build, real Flow360 schema smoke, and browser verification pass.
notes: Flow360 25.10 quantity wire schemas expose {value,units} but omit the physical dimension from JSON schema. The preflight bridge now recovers each field's SI dimension generically from Flow360 Pydantic annotations, propagates it through nullable/union schemas, and generates compatible unit_options. No parameter names are hard-coded. Real browser verified length selector meter/mm/cm/km/inch/ft, velocity selector meter/second/cm/second/ft/second/km/hr/mph/knot, no free-text .units controls, and no overflow. Installed Flow360 schema smoke, Go test/race/vet, 242 Vitest tests, and production build pass.
close_reason: All recognized Flow360 physical quantities now render dimension-aware unit selectors with server-side option validation.

title: Recover AI Create root Geometry ID after project creation
description: AI Create successfully creates a Flow360 Project, but the current CLI create response can contain only the Project ID. normalizeImportResult then fails with 'Flow360 import did not return the root resource ID', leaving a real Project without its local Case plan. Actual affected project prj-88c02308-0a06-4838-a030-a2cbdab8958d exposes root Geometry geo-5ad5216a-4716-4813-b92d-1dee0467a1ca through project items.
acceptance_criteria: AI Create requests synchronous root processing; if create output still omits root ID, backend queries project items and resolves the matching root resource; bounded retries handle eventual consistency; successful recovery creates the local Case plan and navigates to the Project; failure response includes the Project ID for recovery; tests cover project-only create output, delayed item visibility, and normal inline root IDs; full tests/build pass.
notes: Confirmed the reported Project was successfully created asynchronously: prj-88c02308-0a06-4838-a030-a2cbdab8958d, with root Geometry geo-5ad5216a-4716-4813-b92d-1dee0467a1ca returned by flow360 project items. AI Create now calls project create with --sync, then falls back to bounded project-items polling when create returns only project_id. Recovery preserves the original Flow360 result, resolves the typed root, and continues Case-plan creation. Exhausted recovery errors explicitly say the Project was created and include project_id. Added end-to-end project-only response coverage plus delayed visibility and failure tests. Verified go test ./..., 242 Vitest tests, git diff check, and make build.
close_reason: AI Create now treats root creation as asynchronous, waits with --sync, and recovers the Geometry ID through bounded project-items polling; full tests and build pass.

title: Replace Plan JSON patches with stage-aware schema forms and AI fill
description: Plan creation currently requires users to author JSON merge patches. Implement schema-driven forms scoped to the actual source-to-target route (Geometry/SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh/Case combinations), add AI-assisted form filling using resource, baseline, Flow360 schema and CFD context, keep raw JSON as expert-only fallback, and preserve preflight/review/approval safety.
design: Use the installed Flow360 SimulationParams JSON schema as authority. Add a route-aware schema projection API and a controlled reusable form editor. Canonical UI state is structured values; patch JSON is compiled output. Agent receives the same projected schema plus baseline/resource context and returns a reviewable proposal. Source/target route follows Geometry -> SurfaceMesh -> VolumeMesh -> Case, including same-stage Case variation.
acceptance_criteria: Every valid source-to-target route renders only its downstream stages; stage parameter editing uses dynamic schema forms rather than JSON textareas; AI can propose structured form values with assumptions/evidence/provenance and never bypasses validation; compiled patches pass existing server validation and Flow360 preflight; expert raw patch remains available; React/Go tests and production build pass.
notes: Implemented installed-Flow360-schema projections for every valid source-to-target route; sparse dynamic stage forms; AI fill endpoint constrained by active schemas, compilation and Flow360 preflight; expert raw JSON fallback; UI/API/backend tests. Verified Go test/race/vet, 138 Vitest tests, production build, real Flow360 25.10.3 schema smoke, desktop and 390px browser layouts. Browser AI smoke correctly requested missing reference area; a later local Codex provider retry returned 502 timeout after 2m2s, with no validation bypass.
close_reason: Stage-aware schema forms and AI-assisted filling implemented and verified across valid Geometry/SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh/Case routes.

Verified 27 Vitest files / 126 tests, production build, and diff check.

acceptance_criteria: Surface 可切换网格线及至少 Aspect Ratio/Skewness/Minimum Edge Length；Volume 可选择默认和最差质量切片；Case 可显示 Cp/yPlus/velocity magnitude/Mach；字段范围与色标正确；选择/显隐/LOD 有测试；切换资源无明显 GPU 泄漏。

title: 将多阶段 UVF 与网格诊断资产同步到 .vibesim

title: 泛化 Flow360 UVF 资产发现与下载桥接
description: 将 internal/flow360 仅支持 Geometry 的 Python bridge 泛化到 Geometry、SurfaceMesh、VolumeMesh、Case。通过各 ResourceWebApi 直接下载 visualize/manifest/manifest.json，安全解析 manifest 引用的 bin 路径，并按资源类型、LOD 与对象选择下载，不依赖 metadata asset_url，也不调用 Flow360 私有 HTTP API。
design: 复用安装 Flow360 CLI 所在 Python 环境和 SIMCLOUD_PROFILE/FLOW360_APIKEY；ResourceWebApi 类型白名单；远端路径只允许 visualize/manifest 下的规范相对路径；manifest 与单文件/总大小均限额；错误返回 typed capability。
acceptance_criteria: 四类资源均能下载 UVF manifest；Surface/Volume/Case fixture 能解析 default LOD 和字段 sections/bounds；阻止路径穿越、过量文件和超限资产；超时/404/鉴权错误分类明确；Go 单测与真实只读资源探测通过。
notes: Implemented generic Client.ResourceVisualization for Geometry/SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh/Case using the supported Flow360 ResourceWebApi classes and known visualize/manifest paths. Downloads manifest plus exactly one manifest-selected default LOD buffer per SolidGeometry; validates type/id, JSON, canonical .bin paths, default LOD, 64-file cap, 25 MiB per-file/total cap, regular files and 180 s timeout. Added typed VisualizationError kinds and a parsed catalog of render objects, Face/GeometryGroup groups, sections, non-structural fields and bounds. Preserved GeometryVisualization alias for compatibility. Live read-only tests passed on SurfaceMesh sm-41c6a47e (about 10 s), VolumeMesh vm-911c1d77 (about 67 s, 16 objects), and Case case-88018358 (about 34 s). go test ./... and diff check pass.
close_reason: Generic supported Flow360 UVF discovery/download bridge, validation, field catalog, unit tests and three live resource probes are complete.

title: 让 Agent 推荐并预填边界条件恢复方案
description: 问题：当前 entity_assignment 虽使用模型下拉框和 surface 复选框，但仍要求 CFD 用户理解 Assign boundary conditions、自己判断 Wall/Freestream 等含义并手工选择。对 Vibe Simulate 来说，Agent 应先基于现有模型意图、Geometry 实体、Schema 错误和上下文生成推荐，用户只需接受或纠正。当前 ddd 计划已有 Wall(*) 与 Freestream(farfield)，因此可高置信度推断 6 个物理 face 应继承现有 Wall；该推断应以证据和 provenance 呈现，而不是隐藏为默认值。
design: 在 preflight recovery schema 中增加 recommendation contract：recommended_model、recommended_entities、confidence、reason、evidence、provenance。推荐器只从可审计证据推导，优先继承现有有效模型意图，不凭空决定物理类型；高置信度建议自动预填但不自动提交。SchemaForm 将 Assign boundary conditions 改为面向任务的 AI recommendation 卡片，默认展示推荐结果、影响范围和 Change 按钮；高级模型下拉与 surface 选择折叠为可修改选项。提交仍生成新 revision 并自动 preflight。
acceptance_criteria: 当前 ddd 计划打开恢复表单时默认选择现有 Wall 和六个未分配 face；界面用自然语言解释推荐原因、置信度和证据，不要求用户先理解 Assign boundary conditions；用户可一键 Apply AI recommendation，也可展开修改模型或 surface；无文本字段；推荐不会自动提交；服务端校验推荐 choice/entity IDs；React、Go、真实 Flow360 fixture 与浏览器验收通过。
notes: 已实现：preflight bridge 从原始 SimulationParams 中识别现有 wildcard boundary intent，为 entity_assignment 输出 recommended_model、recommended_entities、confidence、reason、evidence 和 provenance；当前 ddd 计划高置信度推荐复用 Wall 并预选六个 face。前端默认展示 Vibe Simulate Recovery / Agent recovery path 卡片、推荐原因、证据、模型与影响面摘要，主按钮为一键 Apply AI recommendation & validate；高级模型下拉与 surface 复选框折叠到 Change recommendation，无文本输入且不自动提交。真实 Flow360 fixture 证明推荐 patch 后 valid=true；ego-browser 证明默认 6 selected、编辑时 Wall + 六项全选；Go test/race/vet、40 Vitest、production build 和 diff check 通过。
close_reason: Agent 已能根据现有模型意图自动推荐并预填边界恢复方案，用户默认只需审查和一键应用。

title: 实现 Agent 主导的 Vibe Simulate 异常恢复闭环
description: 背景：VibeSim 的目标不是让用户手工逐项修复 CFD 表单，而是由 agent 观察仿真过程、理解异常、提出修复方案，并根据用户意见自动调整 SimulationParams。当前 preflight 虽能生成动态表单，但异常恢复仍由用户自行解释和操作，缺少 agent orchestration。范围：为 preflight/schema error、mesh failure、solver failure、convergence anomaly 和 remote execution error 建立统一 Intervention 状态；agent 获取 Project 本地镜像、资源链、当前 plan/revision、semantic diff、Flow360 schema issues 和日志证据；输出原因、置信度、影响、需确认事项和一个或多个 patch proposal；接收用户自然语言反馈后修改 proposal、自动本地验证并持续迭代；仅在最终 schema/工程 gate 通过后进入审批。
design: 建立 Observation -> Diagnosis -> Proposal -> User feedback -> Patch compile -> Local validation -> Re-observe 的有状态 agent loop。每次 intervention 绑定 project/resource/plan revision，产物持久化且可审计。Agent 可以自动执行只读查询、本地 patch 草案、schema preflight 和非付费检查；不得自动批准或启动付费 Flow360 资源。动态 SchemaForm 退居为 request_missing_input action 的结构化补充：agent 应先解释为何需要该信息、推荐值及其工程依据。参数建议必须区分 schema-required、从现有项目继承、agent 推断和用户确认四种 provenance。
acceptance_criteria: 任意 plan preflight error 自动创建可见的 agent intervention，而不是只显示红色错误；agent 能针对缺失边界条件解释原因并生成 Wall/其他边界分配建议；用户用自然语言修改建议后，agent 生成新 revision、显示 semantic diff 并自动 preflight；新错误会继续进入同一闭环直到 valid；mesh/solver/convergence/remote errors 复用统一状态机；所有建议带证据、置信度和 provenance；远程付费执行仍要求显式审批与最终确认；包含持久化恢复、重启续接、Go/React 测试和真实 Flow360 端到端验收。
notes: 2026-07-29 remediation: compiled Agent patch is now applied to the bound plan as a new revision before real Flow360 preflight; invalid retries re-enter the same auditable intervention instead of creating duplicates. Feedback is persisted separately and cannot leak private _feedback fields into SimulationParams. Preflight proposals use signed schema recommendations and never reinterpret issue paths as Geometry IDs. Added plan-specific recovery endpoint so Let Agent resolve creates/returns the exact plan revision, then automatically diagnoses and generates proposals. Empty intervention collections now serialize as [] and the modal no longer crashes. Real production/default browser evidence on ddd plan plan-7bda38521d077a96: one click opened a visible Agent Recovery modal and progressed Diagnosing -> Awaiting selection with 3 proposals; desktop and 390x844 had zero horizontal overflow. Go/race/vet/golangci-lint, 45 Vitest, production build pass. Remaining before closure: user/CFD owner must select or correct the proposed boundary intent for a real apply-and-revalidate loop; convergence/remote terminal trigger evidence should be recorded.
close_reason: Closed

title: 消除时序播放器相机操作卡顿

title: Lazy sync selected project resource and warm project mirror

If missing, fetch the selected resource and its directly relevant artifacts from Flow360 via the CLI/API client, persist them to the local project mirror, return them to the frontend, and concurrently warm-sync the rest of the project so later resource switches are served from local data.

title: 消除时序播放期间相机交互抖动

acceptance_criteria: 播放预览帧不再出现由预览生成导致的三角形缺口；真实 Case 的多个 slice/帧连续播放显示完整；相关后端和前端测试通过。

title: Explain incomplete Case visualization assets without internal fallback copy
description: The Case visualization manifest can exist while referenced binary buffers are missing remotely. Classify incomplete visualization assets with a stable API code and show concise localized user-facing guidance.

title: Stop cross-resource preview fallback and relax Case manifest limit
description: Case resource pages currently fall back to the parent Geometry manifest when the Case visualization is unavailable or exceeds the size guard. acceptance_criteria: CaseWorkspace never requests a Geometry preview as fallback; oversized/missing Case visualization produces a friendly localized Case error; Case manifest remote/download/browser limits are increased with tests; relevant Go and web tests pass.

title: 修复时序播放器字段探测
description: 时序播放器中字段探测工具无法正常工作；定位播放器与 Viewer3D 的探测状态、拾取和多轨资产切换链路，补回归测试并修复。
acceptance_criteria: 播放器暂停后可开启探测并点击表面得到当前字段值；多切片资产可正确探测；现有测试和构建通过。
close_reason: Closed

title: 修复多切片同步播放无法启动
description: 选择多个切片轨道后，时序播放器无法推进。定位组合帧 readiness、Viewer 资产就绪回调与 RAF 播放时钟之间的状态竞态，并补充多轨回归测试。
acceptance_criteria: 选择两个或更多具有公共 step 的切片后可以开始并持续播放；播放器仅在该组合帧的全部资产加载完成后推进；单切片播放不回归；相关测试和构建通过。
notes: 根因：Viewer 多 manifest 加载完成后 onAssetReady 返回完整 viewerManifestSetKey（URL 以 | 拼接），播放器错误地只与第一个 URL 比较，导致多轨组合帧永远无法 ready，RAF 时钟不推进。已恢复完整组合键比较并补充主 URL 不得误判为组合帧 ready 的回归测试。前端全量 140 files/752 tests 通过，生产构建通过；已安装并重启 9292，HTTP 200。
close_reason: 多切片组合帧 readiness 校验已修复并部署。

title: Fix AI draft modification repair preserving schema-valid values
description: The AI draft editor can produce destructive replacements that clear required Flow360 fields (for example refinement faces/types and output surfaces/slices). Autonomous repair then exhausts three attempts instead of recovering a schema-valid candidate from the current draft. Reproduce with draft dft-eec4d9f8-ba42-441c-9b29-699b40108da6, fix the plan composition/repair path, and add regression coverage.
acceptance_criteria: AI draft modification preserves or restores required existing values, preflight succeeds for valid user intents, and automated regression tests cover destructive partial AI output.
notes: Implemented deterministic missing-field recovery from persisted Draft SimulationParams before model repair. Recovery fills only Flow360 errors with code=missing, supports indexed array paths such as meshing.refinements.2.faces and outputs.1.slices, preserves neighboring candidate edits, and leaves unrelated deletions untouched. Added pure merge-patch regression and full generate/preflight integration coverage; go test ./... and make build pass.
close_reason: AI Draft repair now deterministically restores persisted values for Flow360 missing paths (including canonical entities to faces/surfaces/slices aliases), validates entity_list patches, preserves neighboring edits, and passes full tests/build.

title: 修复 Project 进入动画重复与固定进度
description: 进入 Project 资源页时加载动画会关闭后再次出现，共出现两次；详情阶段固定显示 38%。统一加载遮罩生命周期，并根据资源大小估算加载时长来平滑模拟百分比，真实加载完成后快速补到 100%。
acceptance_criteria: 每次进入资源仅展示一次加载动画；进度不固定停在 38%；可用资源大小估算时长；真实加载完成后补到 100% 再关闭；相关测试通过。
notes: Implemented a per-resource loading session latch so late Viewer loading callbacks cannot reopen a completed overlay. Replaced fixed detail/preview percentages with size-estimated linear simulated progress (6 MiB/s heuristic, 6–60 s bounds, 12 s fallback), preserving measured asset progress; completion immediately advances to 100% and closes after 320 ms. Web full suite: 140 files / 746 tests passed; TypeScript and production build passed.
close_reason: Project resource entry now has one loading animation with size-aware estimated progress and deterministic 100% completion.

title: 优化时序播放器缩放与播放流畅度
description: 修复 Viewer3D 鼠标滚轮缩放锚点弹动与高频事件未合并问题；优化时序切片/表面播放器的时钟调度、预取和每帧场景重建开销，优先复用静态拓扑并避免播放期间同步构建拾取 BVH。
acceptance_criteria: 滚轮输入按绘制帧合并且一次手势保持稳定锚点；播放器按时间戳推进并能在落后时跳帧；播放期间不阻塞于拾取 BVH；相同拓扑帧避免重复构建几何/BVH；相关单元测试、类型检查和构建通过。
notes: 已实现：wheel delta 按 RAF 合并、220ms 稳定锚点并临时关闭 OrbitControls 二次阻尼；播放按 wall-clock RAF 调度并在落后时跳帧；播放使用 preview、暂停恢复 full；播放中延迟 BVH，暂停时补建；按 UVF topology key 复用派生法线与序列化 BVH（64 项 LRU）。验证：前端全量 139 files/737 tests、Go ./...、TypeScript/Vite build、make build 均通过；安装至 ~/.local/bin 并重启 launchd，9292 返回 200。
close_reason: 播放器交互与时序切帧优化已实现、测试、构建和部署。

title: 修复大 Slice 下载磁盘不足失败与缓存复用
description: 7.9GB results/slices.tar.gz 在时序切片播放器准备到 5% 时因 OSError 28 磁盘空间不足失败。需要复现任务状态，修复重复下载/空间预检，并给用户可行动的错误提示。
acceptance_criteria: 已有完整归档时复用而不重复下载；空间不足在下载前失败并显示所需/可用空间；相关 Go/Web 测试通过。
notes: Root cause: 8,436,478,895-byte Slice archive was already complete in legacy downloads, but the namespaced store did not reuse it; a failed transfer also left a 503,316,480-byte temporary file. Added exact-size legacy adoption via hard link, pre-download free-space check with 512 MiB reserve, failed-transfer temporary cleanup, and traceback humanization. Real archive adopted into production-default archive with identical inode 306802273/link count 2; duplicate launchd services were removed and one stable service registered with the project working directory. Full Go suite and focused race tests pass.
close_reason: Large Slice now reuses the existing immutable archive, fails early on insufficient disk, cleans transfer debris, and reports actionable errors.

title: 避免 Case 首屏重复下载并缩短详情请求
description: 优化 Case 资源详情与 preview-mesh 首屏链路：复用本地 manifest/资源，避免对已知超大可视化重复远端下载，降低 SimulationParams 失败对详情返回的阻塞，并补充回归测试。
acceptance_criteria: 本地可用的可视化文件不会触发 ResourceVisualization；已知超大 manifest 不会在每次访问时重复下载；Case 详情的结果清单不被 SimulationParams 失败阻塞；相关 Go/前端测试通过。
notes: 已实现：终态 Case 完整/部分详情本地复用，部分详情缓存 15 分钟且显式 force 可刷新；本地可用 UVF manifest 直接返回，缺失 bin 按单文件懒加载；远端 manifest 使用 1-byte Range 在下载前检查大小；超大可视化错误持久缓存 24 小时；Flow360 Python bridge 隔离 stdout。真实 case-b03aae1e：manifest 606,896,896 bytes，仅读 1 byte；preview-mesh 43.05s→首次2.98s、再次1.5ms；详情显式刷新43.51s、再次2.6ms。验证：go test ./...、Web 669 tests、npm build、make build、git diff --check 全通过。
close_reason: Case 首屏重复下载与终态详情重复远端读取已优化并完成真实资源验证。

title: 时序播放器点击 Panel 外部时保持打开
description: 时序 Slice/Surface 播放器承载长时间准备和交互状态，遮罩层误点击不应关闭播放器并丢失当前上下文。仅保留显式关闭按钮和既定键盘关闭行为。
acceptance_criteria: 点击时序播放器 Panel 外部不触发 onClose；显式关闭按钮仍可用；其他 ResourceReviewDialog 默认行为不变；包含前端回归测试。
notes: 已为 ResourceReviewDialog 增加向后兼容的 closeOnBackdropClick 开关，并仅在时序 Slice/Surface 播放器中设为 false。点击 Panel 外遮罩不再关闭；显式关闭按钮与 Escape 保持原行为；其他审查 Dialog 默认仍可点击遮罩关闭。验证：相关 44 项测试、前端全量 667 项测试、npm build 与 make build 均通过。
close_reason: Closed

title: 时序切片播放器：大文件断点续传与单遍准备优化
description: 优化大体积 slices.tar.gz 的准备链路：Flow360 SDK/CLI 提供对象元数据、大小限制和可靠断点续传；VibeSim 使用稳定归档缓存并在重启后恢复任务；将 tar.gz 扫描与帧转换合并为单遍处理。
design: Flow360 侧使用 HEAD 获取 ContentLength/ETag，稳定 .part + sidecar 记录对象身份，Range + IfMatch 续传并原子完成；VibeSim 以 case/path/size 生成归档源键，跨 job 复用下载目录，启动时恢复 queued/running job；sliceplayer 新增 PrepareTarGz 单遍构建索引和播放帧。
acceptance_criteria: 1. 中断下载后再次执行仅请求剩余 Range，ETag 变化时安全重下；2. 超过 max-bytes 在下载前拒绝；3. VibeSim 重启后复用 .part/完整归档并恢复任务；4. 正常准备只解压 tar.gz 一遍；5. 相关单元测试、构建通过。
notes: Implemented Flow360 HEAD metadata, max-bytes preflight, stable .part + identity sidecars, Range/IfMatch resume and atomic completion; added case results stat/get flags. VibeSim now uses source-keyed durable archive directories, resumes interrupted jobs on startup, reuses exact stable files with old CLI compatibility, and runs validation/indexing/VTU conversion in one gzip pass via PrepareTarGz. Added bilingual stages and regression coverage. Flow360 related tests: 69 passed. VibeSim: go test ./... passed, 12 Slice player Vitest tests passed, production build passed.
close_reason: 大文件可靠续传、跨重启归档复用、任务恢复和单遍准备链路均已实现并通过相关测试与完整构建。

title: Fix AI interpretation opening and embed it in result preview side panel
description: The result AI interpretation currently opens as a nested full-screen modal and reports/opening behavior is broken. Embed the interpretation experience as a right-side panel inside ResultTablePreview, preserve retry/close/follow-up behavior, and add regression coverage.
acceptance_criteria: AI interpretation opens on the right side of the existing result preview; chart/table content remains visible; close and retry work; responsive layout remains usable; relevant web tests pass.
close_reason: Embedded AI interpretation in the result preview right side, fixed large-result summary stack overflow and APIError prefix corruption, added provider diagnostics, and verified the real CFL workflow.

title: Implement T07 internal-flow meshing Web tutorial
description: Add a Tutorial Standard v2 lesson for meshing a closed duct/manifold fluid volume with bundled CAD, explicit inlet/outlet/wall semantics, no external farfield, validated Flow360 parameters, bilingual Web guidance, and one-click configured Draft creation.
acceptance_criteria: T07 requires no user upload; provides bundled watertight internal-flow CAD; teaches CFD/internal-flow topology and Flow360 CustomVolume/SeedpointVolume/inlet-outlet workflow; creates a Project and configured Draft from Web without submitting paid computation; includes en/zh-CN coverage and passing tutorial/Web/Go/browser gates.
close_reason: Closed

title: Fix external Codex Node runtime resolution
description: External Codex can pass readiness because the codex script exists, then fail at invocation with exit 127 when its /usr/bin/env node shebang cannot resolve Node in a background service PATH. Resolve the executable consistently, include a colocated runtime directory for invocation, make readiness reflect runtime availability, and add regression coverage.
acceptance_criteria: A Codex CLI installed beside Node runs even when the inherited PATH omits that directory; readiness does not claim availability when the shebang runtime is absent; existing secret filtering and invocation safety remain intact; agent tests pass.
notes: Root cause confirmed: VIBESIM_CODEX_BINARY points to an NVM-installed npm launcher with #!/usr/bin/env node, while the launchd service PATH omits the NVM bin directory. Implemented a shared command resolver used by readiness and invocation, prepending the resolved Codex binary directory to PATH and validating env-shebang runtimes. Added regression tests for colocated Node with an otherwise empty PATH and missing runtime readiness. Full go test ./..., go vet ./..., web production build, and git diff --check pass. Installed and restarted the :9292 service; a real /api/agent/chat/stream external Codex request returned OK.
close_reason: External Codex now resolves its colocated Node runtime under the background service PATH, and the live endpoint succeeds.

title: Load full Case detail after metadata cache
description: Case resource pages stop after loading metadata-only project cache, so results and SimulationParams never refresh and result artifacts display as zero. Keep cache-first rendering but always fetch full live detail and preserve cached content if live refresh fails.
close_reason: Case pages now hydrate full detail after metadata cache, and successful result inventories survive SimulationParams partial failures. Verified 13 artifacts and Slice section on the reported Case.

title: 同一 Flow360 发布线内自动升级并恢复参数读取
description: 当前云端 SimulationParams 25.10.18 高于本地 25.10.17 时，资源读取经本地 SDK 反序列化失败并退化为 SimulationParams unavailable。实现 25.10.* 发布线内的安全自动升级、自检与请求重试；跨发布线返回稳定的应用升级提示，不暴露底层 Python 错误。
design: Vibe Flow360 版本固定支持一个 Flow360 发布线。发布线内允许自动升级，跨发布线由 Vibe Flow360 新版本承接。避免无限重试与并发重复升级。
acceptance_criteria: 同一 25.10 发布线检测到较新云端参数时可自动升级本地 Flow360 工具并重试一次；升级失败不会破坏当前运行时；跨到 25.11 等发布线返回稳定错误码和可翻译提示；现有与新增测试通过。
notes: Fixed the remaining live regression for dft-9d876cac-cae2-40b7-93fe-a9e87ae974c1. Flow360 25.10.18 omitted AutomatedFarfield.method because its schema default is auto, while raw validation indexed zone['method']; preflight now materializes the authoritative installed-schema default only in its validation copy. AI Draft editing now selects requested Draft params before requiring source Geometry params. Live validation reports validator_version 25.10.18 with real missing fields and no method KeyError; /api/plans/form-schema loads the Draft baseline and all three stage schemas without source-unavailable error.
close_reason: Live Draft preflight and AI Draft baseline paths both pass; remaining issues are genuine missing CFD inputs.

title: Stop repeated AI Create canonical-parameter timeout failures
description: AI Create repeatedly fails while loading canonical Flow360 Geometry SimulationParams for an already-created Project. Diagnose whether the remote Geometry is pending, failed, or returning a payload rejected by local readiness checks; make the wait state bounded but realistic, preserve actionable remote diagnostics, and prevent users from manually repeating an unchanged failing poll.
acceptance_criteria: Remote Geometry state and parameter payload readiness are classified explicitly; processing resources receive a realistic resumable wait; terminal remote failures return actionable diagnostics without blind retries; valid canonical payloads are not falsely rejected; regression tests cover delayed readiness and terminal failure.
close_reason: Verified the reported Geometry is processed with complete canonical SimulationParams; replaced the ~10-second fixed poll window with a 5-minute state-driven wait, surfaced parameter-fetch diagnostics, stopped immediately on terminal remote failure, and added delayed-readiness/terminal-state regression tests.

title: Prevent duplicate Flow360 projects on AI Create stage retry
description: Retrying a failed SimulationParams/configuration stage creates a second Flow360 Project instead of reusing the project already associated with the persisted AI Create session. Make project creation idempotent across stage retries and session recovery.
acceptance_criteria: After a project is created, its ID is durably saved before later stages run; retrying parameter/configuration stages reuses that project and never calls project creation again; missing or invalid persisted projects fail safely or follow an explicit recovery path; regression tests cover the failure-then-retry sequence.
close_reason: Persisted Project identity immediately after remote creation, made AI Create resume incomplete Geometry/SimulationParams loading from the saved Project, safely cleared checkpoints only when replacing a defective imported Project, and added failure/retry/backend-restart regression coverage.

title: Harden AI CAD topology generation and recovery
description: AI Create can repeatedly generate an invalid external_fluid solid because CAD recipes are only validated at the final result, repair receives a coarse diagnostic, and failed blueprints/recipes are deleted. Add deterministic per-operation topology evidence, external-domain boolean guardrails, durable failed-attempt artifacts, and focused external-aero Agent guidance.
acceptance_criteria: Each CAD attempt persists its blueprint/recipe and structured diagnostic; invalid source solids and empty/invalid boolean cuts identify the failing operation; external-fluid cuts reject containment/tangency defects before export; repair prompts receive structured evidence; external-aero guidance is injected; unit/integration tests and make install pass.
close_reason: Implemented deterministic external-fluid topology guardrails, corrected CadQuery revolve-axis coordinates, persisted every CAD attempt with structured evidence, injected a validated external-aero CAD Skill, and passed unit, build, and real OpenCascade integration tests.

title: Fix Sessions layout and restore conversation context
description: The routed Sessions page is clipped beneath the fixed TopBar, wastes most of the detail surface, and resumed AI Create dialogs lack enough historical context for users to understand the original request, prior clarification rounds, checkpoints, and next action.

title: Profile large Geometry viewer interaction bottlenecks
description: Diagnose why the 7,000-body Geometry page is slow after large-manifest support. Measure network, manifest parsing, WebGL scene construction, React group-tree rendering, and click interaction costs; report evidence and recommended remediation without changing behavior yet.
notes: Profiled deployed 7,000-body Geometry. Network is secondary: preview 0.924MB/415ms, compact manifest 5.05MB/640ms, cached 51.54MB bin/45ms. Page creates 70,343+ DOM nodes and 7,000 entity rows; load recorded 19 long tasks totaling 13.553s (12.603s TBT), max 2.59s. Selecting a row produced 2.024s EventTiming click, 1.679s handler processing, and 1.716s long task. Ten canvas mouse moves took 14.204s with long tasks up to 2.674s. One wheel event rendered 2 frames with 14,041 drawElements calls (~7,020/frame) and a 629ms long task. Root causes: one Mesh/material/draw call per solid; full recursive raycast on every pointer move without BVH/first-hit/coalescing; 7,000-row non-virtualized React list; O(n^2) group lookup during load/selection; O(n^2) visibility update via per-entity full scene traversal.
close_reason: Performance bottlenecks measured and mapped to concrete rendering, picking, React, and algorithmic code paths; no code changes requested in this diagnostic task.

Full Go tests, 632 web tests, production build, and deployed endpoint validation passed.

title: 阻止 3D 导航手势带动页面滚动或回弹
description: 用户在共享 3D 视图内旋转、滚轮缩放和平移时，浏览器页面会发生滚动或弹动。当前滚轮拦截依赖 React onWheelCapture；React 的根级 wheel 事件可能以 passive 方式注册，preventDefault 在触控板/连续滚轮场景不可靠。需在 Viewer3D DOM 原生层以 passive:false 捕获 wheel，并设置明确的 touch-action/overscroll 隔离，保证画布内手势只操作相机。
acceptance_criteria: 在 3D 区域连续滚轮/触控板缩放、左键旋转、右键平移、触摸手势时，window.scrollX/scrollY 和页面滚动容器 scrollTop 不变化；3D 外部仍可正常滚动；Geometry、SurfaceMesh、VolumeMesh、Case、Compare、Slice 共享生效；单测、TypeScript、构建及真实浏览器回归通过。
notes: 根因确认：React 根级委托 wheel 捕获会被浏览器作为 passive 处理；旧实现虽然 stopPropagation，但 synthetic/native wheel 验证显示 defaultPrevented=false，同时 Viewer3D 计算样式 touch-action/overscroll 均为 auto，导致触控板/滚轮手势仍可驱动页面滚动或系统 rubber-band。修复：在 Viewer3D 容器注册原生 capture + passive:false wheel listener，成功处理后 preventDefault + stopPropagation + stopImmediatePropagation；移除 React onWheelCapture；容器设置 touch-action:none 与 overscroll-behavior:contain。真实浏览器验证 defaultPrevented=true；连续 12 次滚轮、旋转、右键平移后 window scroll 与 viewer rect 不变；注入可滚动页面后，viewer 内滚轮 scrollY=0，viewer 外滚轮 scrollY=800，证明只隔离 3D 区域。Web 全量 110 files/587 tests、TypeScript、production build、diff check 通过。
close_reason: 共享 Viewer3D 已在原生非被动事件层隔离滚轮/触控手势，真实浏览器证明画布内不滚页且画布外滚动正常。

title: 为 3D 悬停、选择和工具拖拽增加 BVH 与帧合并

acceptance_criteria: 10万至百万三角形模型的 hover/选择/probe 不阻塞相机；pointermove 每帧最多一次拾取；拖拽回调每帧最多一次；选择精度与隐藏层规则不回退
notes: Added three-mesh-bvh indexes for Mesh and BatchedMesh with first-hit raycasting and owned-cache disposal. Hover/probe/snap remain RAF-coalesced; control-point dragging is now latest-event-per-frame; camera navigation no longer performs redundant pointermove picks. 100k-triangle and BatchedMesh precision tests pass; all 671 Web tests and production build pass.
close_reason: BVH acceleration and per-frame event coalescing implemented and verified.

title: 重构 3D 导航为动态枢轴工程交互
description: 现有 OrbitControls 使用固定 target，左键同时承担旋转与点选，导致局部浏览不自然。用户补充存在间歇性旋转不响应、滚轮/平移后旋转中心不符合预期。需审计 controls.enabled 生命周期、pointer capture/cancel/leave、工具与 NavCube 事件仲裁，并实现鼠标下表面动态枢轴、空白回退、选择中心和显式锁定策略。
acceptance_criteria: 旋转开始时命中表面则无跳变地更新瞬时枢轴；空白区域行为可预测；任何 pointerup/pointercancel/失焦路径均恢复导航；连续执行旋转→滚轮→平移→旋转不失效且枢轴符合预期；选择、旋转、平移、缩放不冲突；Geometry/SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh/Case/Compare/Slice 使用同一导航规范
notes: 已实现并验证：共享 Viewer3D 的左键旋转改为按下位置表面动态枢轴，采用相机与 look target 围绕枢轴同步刚体旋转，表面点在屏幕上不跳变；空白区域使用当前导航 target。滚轮改为每个滚轮手势只拾取一次光标锚点，并围绕锚点同比缩放相机与 target，保留光标位置和视线方向，不再由 OrbitControls zoomToCursor 把 target 改到自由空间。右键平移保留，中键恢复为 Flow360/OrbitControls 常用缩放。左键 4px 阈值明确区分点选和旋转；仅激活工具才允许控制点截获手势。新增 pointercancel、lostpointercapture、window blur、Escape 统一恢复，释放 pointer capture、工具拖拽、NavCube 和 controls.enabled。单测覆盖表面枢轴屏幕稳定及锚定缩放方向稳定；Web 全量 109 files/585 tests、TypeScript、production build、diff check 通过。真实 SurfaceMesh 页面通过旋转→偏心滚轮→右键平移→再旋转及失焦恢复回归，结束状态均释放。BVH/帧合并仍由独立性能事项 flow360-cli-1jay 跟踪，不再阻塞导航正确性。
close_reason: 共享 3D 动态表面枢轴、光标锚定滚轮、输入仲裁与异常恢复已实现，并通过单元、构建及真实页面连续交互验收。

title: 将共享 3D 查看器改为按需渲染
description: Viewer3D 当前永久 requestAnimationFrame，并在每帧重复更新裁剪、线框和 NavCube；同时固定 DPR=2 且 preserveDrawingBuffer 常开。改为 invalidation/on-demand render，交互和动画期间连续渲染，静止时休眠；截图时临时保留帧；按性能自适应 DPR。
acceptance_criteria: 所有 Viewer3D 消费页面静止时停止连续主场景提交；旋转平移缩放保持目标 60fps；截图正常；线框与裁剪只在相机/状态变化时更新；低性能设备自动降低 DPR
notes: 已实现共享 Viewer3D 按需渲染：新增可测试的 ViewerRenderScheduler，将多次 invalidation 合并为单个 animation frame；controls change、React 场景/材质/覆盖层状态、尺寸变化与动画按需唤醒，OrbitControls 阻尼在 render 内再次 change 时自动续帧，静止后不再请求帧。主场景、动态裁剪、线框屏幕宽度、LIC 和 NavCube 只在有效帧更新。WebGL preserveDrawingBuffer 改为 false，截图请求在同一任务内显式 render+composite 后立即 toDataURL；真实页面成功下载 73,527-byte PNG。新增基于 hardwareConcurrency/deviceMemory 的 DPR 上限：高性能最多 2，低端降至 1.5/1.25。真实 SurfaceMesh 通过 WebGL draw 拦截验证：静置 2 秒 draw delta=0；旋转产生 49 次 draw 后再次静置 delta=0；模拟 2 核/2GB 时 868px CSS canvas buffer=1085px，DPR=1.25。Web 全量 111 files/591 tests、TypeScript、production build、diff check 通过。
close_reason: 共享 3D 已改为失效驱动渲染，静止零绘制、交互按需续帧、自适应 DPR 与无常驻缓冲截图均通过真实页面和全量测试验收。

acceptance_criteria: Document the concrete cause of READY versus preview failure, identify which metadata fields are trustworthy or misleading, and compare computed typography with established Project UI styles. Do not change behavior unless explicitly requested.
notes: Findings: stored file is intact (5455 bytes, SHA-256 1809bfb90544ce214b243e82c6e4ac769e1334be6f3887c17c46e9362f23495e). STEP declares SI metre units and represents radii as 0.01/0.05 m. CadQuery 2.6.1/OpenCascade normalizes import geometry to mm and reports 1 solid, 4 faces, 150796.447 mm^3, bounds +/-50 x +/-10 x +/-50 mm. UI incorrectly labels kernel values using upload-selected unit m, yielding misleading 150796.4 m^3. Direct preview under matching isolated UV/CadQuery environment succeeds with 1012 vertices/1008 triangles, while HTTP preview reproducibly returns 422 importStep failure, so file is valid and service preview invocation/runtime context is inconsistent. UI leaks full Python traceback. Computed typography uses shared Manrope/PingFang stack and matching 44px route heading, but STEP metadata labels/values are both 9px proportional text; Project uses 10-11px proportional primary text and 7px DM Mono for technical metadata, so semantic typography is only partially aligned.

acceptance_criteria: AI STEP design returns an accepted durable job; job state survives backend restart; progress and failure stages are visible; successful jobs create immutable ready versions; UI polls and resumes without holding the original request.
close_reason: Closed

title: Add independent STEP geometry asset library
description: Implement a workspace-level STEP library independent of Flow360 Projects. Users can upload exact STEP files, keep immutable versions, validate geometry, inspect validation state, optionally download a version, select a validated version to create a Flow360 Project directly, and choose a library version as the geometry source in AI Create. AI-authored revisions must create new versions rather than overwrite existing files.
acceptance_criteria: A persistent API and UI list STEP assets and versions; STEP uploads are safely stored and validated; validation reports exact CAD evidence and readiness; downloads are optional; a selected library version can create a Flow360 geometry Project without browser re-upload; AI Create can use a library version; tests cover storage, validation, routes, and primary UI flows.
close_reason: Implemented independent persistent STEP assets and immutable versions, upload and AI authoring/revision, asynchronous exact OpenCascade validation with restart recovery, optional download, direct Flow360 Project creation, Workspace and AI Create entry points, Chinese locale coverage, and backend/frontend tests.

title: 恢复 Case animation manifest 的 3D 交互
description: Case 云端 manifest 中 Wake_animation 对应 midspan SolidGeometry，包含 125 个 animation 帧；旧规范化器只支持 buffers/lod 并错误裁掉 animation 节点。支持选择最新 animation 帧作为主 3D 预览、下载对应 Buffer，并用版本标记自动刷新旧缓存。
acceptance_criteria: 非空 animation SolidGeometry 保留层级并选择最新帧；主预览支持选择、显示隐藏、三角形统计和字段能力；旧 Case manifest 缓存自动刷新；空 animation 仍安全裁掉；目标 Case 与全量测试通过。
notes: 目标 Case 实测：Wake_animation/midspan 有 125 帧，修复后主 preview 返回 145136 tris。Cylinder_surface 节点存在但 frames=[]，需从 surfaces.tar.gz 合并，拆分为后续 issue。
close_reason: 已支持 Case 非空 animation manifest，目标 Wake_animation 最新帧已实测进入主 3D preview（145136 tris）并自动刷新旧缓存；空 Surface animation 的归档图层合并已拆分跟踪。

title: 修正 Case 结果组级可见状态与整组恢复
description: Case 结果清单中的表面、切片、等值面等分组按钮应汇总组内实际可见性。仅当组内所有成员隐藏时显示隐藏状态；点击隐藏组按钮应恢复整组显示。
acceptance_criteria: 组内至少一个成员可见时不显示全隐藏状态；全部成员隐藏时显示隐藏状态；点击后所有组成员恢复可见；中英文无障碍文案正确；相关测试通过。
close_reason: 组级图标已反映聚合可见状态；全隐藏时单击恢复全部成员，并通过单测、类型检查、构建及真实页面验证

title: 修复 Case 可视化输出项缺失
description: Case case-5d39dfb5-2b62-4f77-aec9-2d9c03548b2a 在 Flow360 输出定义中有 Surface output、Boundaries (Auto)、Wake_animation Slice 和 Isosurfaces (Auto) 四项，但 Vibe Case 左侧只显示两个 UVF 叶子实体。对齐 SimulationParams 输出定义、manifest 分组和可渲染实体映射，使所有输出项都显示并呈现正确的可操作/不可用状态。
acceptance_criteria: 目标 Case 左侧按 surfaces/slices/isosurfaces/streamlines 分类显示四个输出项；有 UVF 几何的项可选择显隐和 Field；定义存在但无渲染实体的项仍显示且给出明确状态；不伪造几何或计数；测试与构建通过

title: Implement T06 automated versus user-defined farfield Web tutorial
description: Build T06 as a Tutorial Standard v2 Web lesson that teaches external-domain selection, AutomatedFarfield versus UserDefinedFarfield, enclosed-entity requirements, boundary-distance reasoning, controlled comparison, and one-click Project plus configured VolumeMesh Draft creation from bundled assets.

title: 完善 Case 折叠分组与 Slice 归档入口
description: Case 左侧所有可视化分类和结果工件默认折叠；当 manifest 不含静态 slices 但 results/slices.tar.gz 存在时，在 Slices 分类显示明确的时序播放器入口；核对并修复跨对象字段缺失时的着色恢复行为。

title: 缓存 CSV AI 解读并支持弹窗多轮会话
description: 将 CSV AI 解读改为按数据指纹、语言、模型与提示词版本持久缓存的独立弹窗。弹窗恢复基础解读和会话历史，支持继续追问、重新解读、清空会话，并提供友好的 Markdown 标题、表格、列表、代码和窄屏渲染。

close_reason: 已实现 CSV AI 解读缓存、CFD 字段说明、弹窗多轮会话与友好 Markdown 渲染，并通过完整测试和生产构建

title: 按 Case manifest 分类重构左侧对象树
description: 移除 Case 左侧重复字段可视化列表；根据 manifest root_group 下 boundaries、slices、isosurfaces、streamlines 的层级，将可渲染对象分组展示，并保持统一 3D Field 面板可切换字段。
acceptance_criteria: Case 左侧不再显示重复字段列表；对象按 Surfaces/Slices/Isosurfaces/Streamlines 分类；空分类不显示；组显隐和选择仍可用；Viewer Field 下拉可更新当前字段；相关测试与构建通过。
close_reason: 已移除 Case 左侧重复字段列表，按 manifest 层级实现 Surfaces/Slices/Isosurfaces/Streamlines 分类，支持无 Face SolidGeometry 等值面，并完成全量测试与构建。

title: 修复本地 convergence 接口间歇不可用
description: Case convergence 数据本身可正常解析，但本地 9292 同时存在受 launchd 管理的等待进程和遗留监听进程，导致请求间歇连接失败。清理遗留进程并确认 launchd 实例接管端口。
acceptance_criteria: 9292 仅保留一个受 launchd 管理的 vibe-flow360 进程；目标 Case convergence 返回 HTTP 200 和 residual/forces assessment；服务日志不再持续输出端口占用等待。
close_reason: Removed the stale listener process and let the launchd-managed instance acquire :9292. The target convergence endpoint now returns HTTP 200 with residual and force assessments; subsequent cached response is about 142 ms and only one listener remains.

title: 让字段着色默认使用 Turbo 并匹配色条亮度
description: 播放器和通用 UVF Viewer 当前默认使用 viridis；字段顶点色经过 MeshPhong 光照后明显暗于 UI 色条。将默认色图改为 turbo，并调整字段着色材质，使结果颜色忠实匹配色条且保留适度曲面明暗层次。
acceptance_criteria: 首次字段着色默认选择 turbo；模型主体颜色与色条具有一致的色相和接近的亮度/饱和度；关闭字段后恢复普通受光材质；相关 UVF/Viewer 测试、生产构建和真实页面视觉验收通过。
close_reason: Turbo is now the default colormap. Field-colored UVF surfaces use an unlit, non-tone-mapped vertex-color material so rendered colors remain vivid and faithful to the legend; clearing the field restores the original lit material. 487 web tests, production build, and real 401-frame browser validation passed.

title: 3D 视图按可见区域适应窗口并增加探测工具
description: 调整 3D Viewer 的 Fit，使相机只包围当前可见实体；增加显式探测工具，点击表面时同时显示 surface 与当前 field 信息；梳理 VolumeMesh manifest.json 的实际结构特点。
acceptance_criteria: 隐藏实体不参与 Fit bounds；探测工具可开关且点击后显示 surface 名称/标识、字段名/值/位置；新增用户文案接入 en 与 zh-CN；相关测试通过。
close_reason: Fit now frames only visible rendered geometry; explicit Probe tool reports surface, field value, and position; full Web tests/build plus real VolumeMesh browser verification passed.

title: 增强 CSV AI 解读的 CFD 字段语义
description: 现有 CSV AI 解读偏通用统计，需要结合 CFD 与 Flow360 求解器知识，逐字段解释字段含义、常见命名和单位语境，并结合字段关系作出有证据边界的诊断。未知字段或单位必须明确不确定，不得臆测。
acceptance_criteria: AI 输出必须包含字段说明章节并覆盖请求中的每个字段；识别常见 step/residual/continuity/momentum/energy/force/moment/coefficient/CFL 等字段语义；结合字段关系分析趋势；未知含义和单位明确标注需结合文件类型或 SimulationParams 确认；回归测试验证 prompt contract。
close_reason: 已将 CSV AI 解读升级为 CFD/Flow360 专用字段语义与联合诊断，强制逐字段说明、稳态/非稳态收敛区分和单位/归一化不确定性边界，并增加 prompt contract 回归测试。

title: 修复 Slice 播放时自动切换损坏的预览网格
description: 时序 Slice 播放器暂停时显示全分辨率帧，播放/拖动时自动切换 preview_manifest。目标 Case 的预览抽稀网格存在大量缺面，导致播放画面与暂停画面完全不同。需要确保同一帧在播放和暂停状态下使用一致可靠的几何数据，并验证 401 帧播放性能。
acceptance_criteria: 播放、暂停和拖动同一帧使用一致的全分辨率资产；不再出现预览缺面；播放器状态标签准确；测试、构建和目标 Case 实际播放通过。
close_reason: 已移除播放/拖动时自动切换 preview manifest；401 帧实测全程只请求完整帧，98 个测试文件共 479 个用例通过，前端构建通过

title: 修复 Slice 播放器底部空白与逐帧闪烁
description: Case 时序切片播放器中 3D 画布未填满播放器视口，控制条上方出现明显空白；播放时帧资源切换导致画布反复进入空场景/加载态并闪烁。需要修复布局尺寸和无闪烁帧切换，保持相机及字段范围稳定，并用目标 Case 的 401 帧缓存验收。
acceptance_criteria: 播放器画布填满控制条上方可用区域；连续播放不出现空白帧闪烁；相机和字段选择保持稳定；构建、测试与目标 Case 浏览器验收通过。
close_reason: 播放器视口高度修复；帧切换改为保留旧帧、后台加载后原子替换，并在入场前应用字段着色。479 项测试、完整构建及 401 帧连续播放验收通过。

title: 为 Case slices.tar.gz 增加播放器打开入口
description: Case 结果列表中的 slices.tar.gz 目前只显示文件名和 .GZ，没有可操作入口。需要将该工件接入已有时序切片播放器，支持点击打开准备/查看流程，并完成 i18n、测试和目标 Case 页面验收。
acceptance_criteria: slices.tar.gz 显示可访问的打开操作；点击进入时序切片播放器；普通 tar.gz 行为不被误改；中英文文案与测试通过。
close_reason: slices.tar.gz 结果行已接入时序切片播放器；完整构建、478 项前端测试及目标 Case 浏览器验收通过

title: 为 CSV 图表增加数据点提示与 AI 解读
description: CSV 结果预览需要在图表数据点 hover/focus 时展示对应 field/value，并提供针对当前整份 CSV 数据的 AI 解读入口、状态和结果展示。所有用户可见文案需接入中英文 i18n，并补充测试。
acceptance_criteria: 图表数据点可通过鼠标 hover 查看横轴与各 series 的 field/value；用户可点击 AI 解读并得到当前 CSV 的结构化解读；加载、错误和结果状态完整；中英文文案与测试覆盖。

title: 修复 Case UVF 归一化后的悬空 GeometryGroup 引用
description: Case 时序流场播放器加载失败：归一化 manifest 删除无 buffer 的 SolidGeometry 后仍保留 GeometryGroup.members 悬空引用。需递归清理成员/父子引用、移除空组，并自动刷新已有旧缓存。验收目标 Case 页面可正常显示。
close_reason: 已修复悬空 UVF 引用、递归空组清理、旧缓存自动刷新与 manifest 内容指纹；目标 Case 页面浏览器验证通过

title: 修复 Case preview-mesh 返回 503
description: CaseWorkspace 请求 /resources/Case/:id/preview-mesh 时返回 503，尽管 Case detail 和 Flow360 visualization capability 可用，导致 3D 主视图只能尝试 Geometry fallback。
acceptance_criteria: 目标 Case preview-mesh 返回 200 flow360-uvf manifest；所需 visualization manifest/bin 可按需同步并缓存；增加 Case 回归测试并验证真实接口。
notes: Root cause had three layers: Case manifest exceeded the old 2 MiB Geometry limit; it contained non-renderable SolidGeometry placeholders without buffer paths; and the Case detail existed only in the API cache so the Project mirror lacked its project identity. Raised the bounded Go/browser manifest cap to 8 MiB, normalize empty placeholders while rejecting unsafe paths, preserve visualization errors, and self-repair mirror identity from cached/live detail. Real target endpoint now returns 200 flow360-uvf with 3803 vertices, 624 triangles, one group; normalized manifest is 17611 bytes/9 entries and both referenced bins return 200. Live visualization probe, all Go packages, 476 Web tests, and production build pass.
close_reason: Reported Case preview-mesh and all referenced UVF assets now return 200 on the installed official local service.

title: 修复 Case 详情接口误用 Geometry 类型
description: Case 详情页同时请求 cache=only 和 live resource detail 时返回 Flow360 resource detail is unavailable；错误 partial 把 case-* ID 标记为 Geometry，导致详情无法显示。
acceptance_criteria: Case 资源详情请求始终使用 Case 类型；cache-only 可命中正确镜像或明确 miss；live 接口返回 Case info/state/summary/simulation_params；增加回归测试并通过 Go/Web 测试。
notes: Root cause: Gin static /resources/Case/:resource_id route does not populate :resource_type, and the shared handler defaulted missing type to Geometry. Added resource-ID prefix normalization that also repairs stale Project snapshot types at the API boundary. Verified target Case directly with Flow360 CLI info/state/summary/simulation-params; focused and full Go tests pass; installed and restarted local service; live and cache-only endpoints both return 200 with type Case, completed status, info, simulation params, and summary.
close_reason: Case static route and cache namespace corrected, regression-tested, deployed locally, and both reported endpoints verified.

title: 验证真实多帧非定常 Slice 播放
description: 寻找包含多个全局 time step 的真实 Flow360 Case results/slices.tar.gz，验证帧排序、固定全局色标、拓扑去重以及 Preview/Full 自动切换。
acceptance_criteria: 至少一个真实多帧非定常 Case 完整转码并可播放；记录帧数、step 范围、缓存占用和峰值内存。
notes: Validated Case case-5d39dfb5-2b62-4f77-aec9-2d9c03548b2a from a fresh 492,490,038-byte slices archive: 126 frames, steps 8..1000, 126 Preview/Full frames, 2 topology blobs (4,003,152 B), 494,205,768 B fields, 498,208,920 B cache. Full conversion 45.149s; sampled peak heap 9,338,880 B (+8,495,104 B). Global ranges cover every frame range.
close_reason: Real multi-frame unsteady Slice fully transcoded and measured.

title: 将 Flow360 PVTU/VTU Slice 索引转为可播放 UVF 帧
description: 在已完成的大文件安全准备和索引基础上，实现真正的时序 Slice 可视化：解析 PVTU 引用的 procN VTU 分片，识别非定常全局 time step，验证静态拓扑，去重 position/index，按 Slice/字段/小帧块生成浏览器可随机访问的 UVF 时序资产，并接入播放/暂停/逐帧/拖动/倍速/全局色标。
design: 复用 Case capability 层与现有 UVF Viewer，不把时间语义写入通用 UVF manifest。转码器从小型 PVTU/PVD 元数据建立 piece/frame 图，再流式读取 VTU appended data。优先静态拓扑 hash 去重，失败时显式回退完整帧。播放器前取 2 帧后留 1 帧、LRU 限制 3–6 帧，快速拖动取消旧请求；播放用 Preview LOD，暂停加载全分辨率。
acceptance_criteria: 真实 PVTU/VTU Slice 可在 Case 页面显示；procN 分片按同一 Slice 合并；拓扑一致时只存一份网格；字段数据按有界块读取且浏览器内存不随总帧数增长；支持播放、暂停、逐帧、拖动、倍速和固定全局色标；暂停可切换全分辨率；至少用一个多帧非定常 Case 验证全局 time step；Go/Web 性能与正确性测试通过。
notes:
2026-08-09 stage 2: implemented real inline-binary VTU to UVF conversion, procN grouping, bounded generated-cache size, immutable asset API, global field ranges, and UI play/pause/step/scrub/fps controls. Verified real Case archive: 103404 vertices, 203625 triangles, Mach/Qcriterion/vorticity, 5.75 MB UVF binary.
