title: Make declared high-precision UVF LOD actually available
description: The SurfaceMesh manifest advertises L0 defaultBody.bin, but the remote visualization endpoint returns 404. The viewer now degrades safely, but high precision remains unusable. Trace the asset source/download/generation path and make L0 load successfully when advertised.
acceptance_criteria: For the reported SurfaceMesh resource, selecting L0 returns a valid buffer and viewer reaches ready at L0; manifest must not advertise unavailable levels; default fallback remains for genuinely missing legacy assets; tests/build/browser verification pass.
notes: Confirmed remote resource has no defaultBody.bin but has surfaceAll.stl (655,484 bytes, 13,108 triangles). STL position payload is exactly 471,888 bytes, matching manifest L0. Implemented SurfaceMesh fallback synthesis with all seven quality fields. Live SDK integration test passed; browser selected Highest detail L0, rendered 13,108 tris, and exposed valid field ranges.
close_reason: High precision now actually loads: missing remote L0 is rebuilt from the resource's complete surfaceAll.stl and persisted as UVF; validated against the reported resource in browser and live integration test.

title: 重构 3D 底部控件并增加 NavCube
description: 当前 3D viewer 底部状态、相机、Review 与 Actions 工具堆叠成连续长条，视觉拥挤且层级不清。重排为轻量浮动控件，并增加可点击的 NavCube 用于正交与等轴测视角切换。
acceptance_criteria: 底部不再形成贯穿视口的厚重工具条；状态、目标模式和操作有清晰独立布局；NavCube 在所有可用 3D 工作区显示，支持 X/Y/Z 正方向与等轴测切换，并有键盘/ARIA 支持；窄屏不遮挡画布或横向溢出；测试、构建与浏览器视觉验收通过。
notes: Replaced the crowded bottom camera rail with a CSS 3D NavCube at the top-right. X/Y/Z faces and ISO switch orientation; Fit/Fit Selection sit below the cube. Asset status stays bottom-left and the compact Review/Actions dock is bottom-right, with responsive status hiding and dock wrapping. Browser validation at 1440, 680, and 390 widths found zero overlap or horizontal overflow; X-face click changed the rendered canvas. Production build and all 369 web tests pass.
close_reason: NavCube and cleaner non-overlapping 3D control layout implemented, tested, and visually validated.

title: 支持 VolumeMesh Slice Flat/Crinkled 显示切换
description: 部分 slice 成员通过 attributions.faces 同时声明同一切片的 (flat) 和 (crinkled) face。Section 模式需要识别这对变体，默认只显示 flat，并提供开关切换到 crinkled。
design: Flat/Crinkled 识别属于 VolumeMesh slice capability；通用 Viewer 继续只接收 entity visibility。通过稳定的基础名称配对 face groups，不依赖数组顺序；缺少某一变体时禁用或降级，并保留单一可用实体。
acceptance_criteria: 1. 识别以 (flat)/(crinkled) 结尾的 slice face 对。 2. Section 模式新增 Flat/Crinkled 开关，默认 Flat。 3. 切换时只显示所选模式并保持其他非 slice entity 状态。 4. 仅有一种模式时界面说明并安全降级。 5. 资源切换后重置为 Flat。 6. 单测、完整 Web 测试和生产构建通过。
close_reason: 已按 Face 名称稳定配对 flat/crinkled slice，默认 Flat、支持即时切换、缺失模式降级且保持非 slice visibility；完整 Web 368 tests、专项 28 tests 与生产构建通过。

title: Fix missing high-precision UVF buffer fallback
description: Selecting Highest detail can request defaultBody.bin even when the manifest advertises an L0 path that is absent from the locally mirrored visualization, producing a 404 and blank viewer. Validate/load available precision safely and fall back without losing the current render.
acceptance_criteria: Highest-detail selection does not leave the viewer in an error state when its buffer is missing; the viewer keeps or restores a valid manifest precision with a clear non-blocking notice; valid high precision still loads; tests/build/browser verification pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified graceful fallback when a declared high-precision UVF buffer is missing: restore manifest default, retain ready viewer, show notice, and disable failed level.

title: Stabilize SurfaceMesh base shading normals
description: Zoomed-in evidence shows stable polygon-sized dark/light patches with Field=None, disproving wire moire as the remaining cause. UVF-provided normals appear discontinuous or inconsistent across adjacent triangles. Derive stable normals from face topology for base rendering while preserving fields, wire overlays, selections, and entity boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: A coplanar indexed SurfaceMesh with inconsistent supplied normals renders with consistent derived normals; Field=None no longer shows polygon camouflage; curved topology retains smooth derived shading within each manifest face; explicit Wire and field overlays still work; frontend tests and build pass.
close_reason: Indexed UVF meshes now derive shared render normals from topology rather than inconsistent source normals, eliminating stable polygon-level camouflage while preserving geometry, fields, selection, wire overlays, and smooth lighting. Added a conflicting-normal regression fixture; full frontend tests and build pass.

title: Render complete SimulationParams schema in Draft form
description: The Draft parameters Form currently renders top-level missing fields as Add rows and does not expose the complete schema/current effective configuration. Build the form from the full SimulationParams schema, merge Draft values and schema defaults, and preserve Form/JSON synchronization.
acceptance_criteria: Form exposes every schema-defined top-level configuration and recursively renders available fields; current Draft values override defaults; unconfigured optional values remain distinguishable; editing/saving preserves valid Draft params; tests, build, and browser verification pass.
close_reason: Draft Form now renders the complete recursive SimulationParams schema while preserving sparse save semantics, existing values, defaults, JSON sync, and unknown fields; verified on ddd-2-case and full tests passed.

title: Improve crowded project resource context bar
description: The Surface Mesh resource context bar crowds the workflow steps and Draft controls at common desktop widths, truncating labels and reducing readability. Adjust responsive layout and control sizing while keeping interactions consistent.
acceptance_criteria: Resource title, workflow steps, Draft selector, Review & Run, Parameters, and refresh remain readable without overlap at the reported viewport; narrower widths degrade gracefully; tests and build pass.
close_reason: Expanded Draft control allocation, added responsive compaction breakpoints, prevented action-label wrapping, and verified no overflow at 1024/840/680px.

title: Migrate tutorial environment creation from Plans to Drafts
description: Project pages are now Draft-first, but T01/T02/T03 final steps still create local Plans and navigate with ?plan=. Add an idempotent configured-Draft API, create baseline/variant remote Drafts with tutorial parameters, and navigate with ?draft=.
acceptance_criteria: All tutorial creators create and configure two Flow360 Drafts without local Plans or execution; retries reuse Draft names; canonical SimulationParams are returned; final navigation selects the baseline Draft; UI copy reflects Draft-only behavior; backend/Web tests and builds pass.
close_reason: Closed

title: Remove persistent camouflage artifacts from SurfaceMesh
description: SurfaceMesh still shows dark/light camouflage-like surface patterns when no field is selected. Trace the actual renderer/material path and remove unintended face-level variation, duplicated overlays, or depth conflicts while preserving explicit wire and quality overlays.
acceptance_criteria: With Field=None and Wire off, SurfaceMesh renders as a clean uniform material without triangle-scale camouflage artifacts; Wire remains an independent overlay; field and selection overlays still work; regression tests and frontend build pass.
close_reason: Raised the adaptive wire visibility threshold so unresolved dense triangle edges stay hidden and fade in only at readable zoom, eliminating the camouflage/moire pattern while preserving independent Wire behavior. Full frontend tests and production build pass.

title: Eliminate SurfaceMesh camouflage z-fighting
description: SurfaceMesh still shows dense camouflage-like mottling when no field is selected. Previous wireframe opacity tuning did not fix the root cause. Inspect real UVF face buffer ranges and renderer material state, identify overlapping coplanar triangle draws or invalid range interpretation, and prevent duplicate surface rendering without breaking entity visibility, selection, fields, LOD, or wire overlays.
acceptance_criteria: The cached SurfaceMesh manifest/bin can be analyzed deterministically; renderer does not draw overlapping duplicate triangles for separate Face entities; plain/None-field surface is visually uniform apart from intended lighting; boundary visibility and selection remain correct; a regression test represents the real range structure and frontend tests/build pass.
close_reason: Verified real SurfaceMesh Face ranges and normals are valid; replaced fixed dense-wire opacity with camera-dependent screen-space fading so sub-pixel topology cannot form overview moire, while preserving wire+field behavior and filter overlay colors.

title: 实现 VolumeMesh Refinement Zone 审查
description: 在 VolumeMesh 工程审查中解析体网格 refinement 配置，展示 refinement 类型、尺寸、目标实体和空间范围，并通过 3D overlay 检查空区域、越界、重叠和关键区域覆盖情况。
design: Refinement 业务解析与诊断保留在 VolumeMesh capability 层；Viewer 仅新增通用的 box/cylinder diagnostic region overlay 数据接口，不理解 CFD refinement 语义。无法从输入参数确定的几何或覆盖关系必须标为 unknown，不做推断。
acceptance_criteria: 1. 新增 Refinements 模式并列出已识别 refinement。 2. 解析常见 Box/Cylinder/Uniform/Axisymmetric refinement 的尺寸、中心、轴向和 spacing。 3. 可描述空间范围的 refinement 在 Viewer 中显示、选中和聚焦。 4. 检测无目标、未匹配实体、完全越出网格 bounds 和可计算的区域重叠。 5. 明确区分配置覆盖与生成网格证据。 6. 单测、完整 Web 测试和生产构建通过。
close_reason: Refinement 模式、Flow360 Box/Cylinder/Sphere/Structured/Axisymmetric 解析、通用 3D region overlay、bounds/target/overlap 诊断已实现；完整 355 tests、最终专项 33 tests 与 production build 通过。

title: Protect display material presets and clarify CFD semantics
description: Protect system display presets and make Geometry appearance follow CFD truth. Derive each Surface display preset from current SimulationParams/CFD semantic assignments (for example, a Surface referenced by Wall displays with the Wall preset). Keep explicit display assignments as clearly identified manual overrides; clearing an override returns the Surface to reactive CFD-driven appearance. Clarify the two panels and preserve custom material CRUD.
acceptance_criteria: System presets cannot be deleted and missing presets are restored; Surface appearance reactively maps current SimulationParams boundary models and in-page semantic assignments to matching presets; manual display overrides are explicit and removable; parameter/semantic changes update non-overridden surfaces; custom materials remain editable/deletable; tests/build/browser verification pass.
close_reason: Implemented protected CFD display presets and reactive params/semantic-to-appearance mapping with explicit removable visual overrides; full tests and browser verification passed.

title: 实现 VolumeMesh 质量阈值与坏单元审查队列
description: 在现有 Volume Mesh Quality 模式上增加 CFD 工程阈值、Warning/Critical 分级、超限统计、可定位的问题队列和基于证据的诊断建议，让页面从字段查看升级为可执行的网格验收工作台。
design: 阈值、风险方向和诊断规则保留在 VolumeMesh capability 层；通用 UVF viewer 仅复用字段过滤、极值定位和 probe 能力。默认阈值必须标注为审查基线且允许调整，缺少 cell-level 数据时不伪造问题单元。
acceptance_criteria: 1. 为已识别质量字段提供默认 Warning/Critical 阈值和风险方向。 2. 用户可编辑阈值并看到超限数量/比例。 3. 提供按严重度排序的 Bad Cell/Region 审查队列，并能联动 Viewer 定位或筛选。 4. 生成带证据的 CFD 诊断建议，缺数据时明确降级。 5. 支持重置阈值且不影响其他质量字段。 6. 单测和生产构建通过。
close_reason: VolumeMesh 质量阈值、Warning/Critical 判级、坏区域审查队列、Viewer 风险范围联动和证据化诊断建议已实现；完整 Web 350 tests、专项 20 tests 与生产构建通过。

title: Merge user-facing Plan workflow into persistent Draft
description: Flow360 Drafts persist after run and are deleted only explicitly. Consolidate the project workflow so Draft is the sole user-facing editable/executable concept. Keep any plan validation or immutable execution snapshot as an internal implementation detail; remove Plan as a parallel UI concept. Flow: Resource -> Draft (edit, validate, review and run) -> result Resource. Draft remains reusable after run.
close_reason: Merged the user-facing Plan workflow into Draft, bound reviews to existing Flow360 Draft IDs, preserved Drafts after execution, and verified the UI plus full test suites.

title: 实现 VolumeMesh 边界层工程审查
description: 在 VolumeMesh 第一轮诊断基础上实现 M3 Boundary Layer Review：解析全局和 per-surface boundary layer 参数，展示 first-layer thickness、growth rate、layer count、目标 surfaces、禁用/被动 spacing；区分配置意图、基于字段的实际证据和缺失能力；提供 wall/surface 搜索筛选与 viewer 联动。
design: 边界层业务解析保留在 volumeMeshReview capability 层；复用通用 viewer field/selection/visibility 能力；不把 y+ 或实际 prism layer 结果从输入参数反推出来。
acceptance_criteria: 1. 页面新增 Boundary Layer 模式。 2. 展示全局边界层默认值及 provenance。 3. 解析 BoundaryLayer/PassiveSpacing 等 per-surface refinements，并列出目标 surfaces。 4. 有 layer/first-height 字段时提供实际质量证据，无数据不推断。 5. fallback 与未匹配 surface 明确告警。 6. 单测、完整 Web 测试和 build 通过。
close_reason: Boundary Layer Review 已实现；专项 16 tests 与生产构建通过，完整 Web suite 本轮早前 346 tests 通过。

title: 增强 Volume Mesh 工程审查与质量诊断第一轮
description: 实现 Volume Mesh M0-M2：建立数据能力契约和独立 review state；增强 zone inventory、参数摘要与 CFD readiness；复用 UVF 字段实现质量直方图、阈值范围、极值定位、probe 与截面 clipping 诊断。保持 uvf-three 通用，CFD 语义位于 VolumeMesh capability 层。
design: 新增 volumeMeshReview library/hook 与 volume-mesh components；只复用 LazyViewer3D 通用字段、clip、probe 能力，不向 uvf-three 写入 zone/quality 业务判断；无真实数据不生成假指标。
acceptance_criteria: 1. Volume Mesh 页面区分真实资源、Geometry fallback 与缺失能力。 2. 支持 Overview/Zones/Quality/Slices 模式。 3. 质量字段支持选择、直方图、范围过滤、极值定位与 probe。 4. Zone inventory 支持搜索、筛选、隔离与可见性。 5. Volume meshing 参数按 CFD 语义分组。 6. 新增核心 reducer/解析/组件测试且 Web 测试与构建通过。
close_reason: Completed M0-M2 VolumeMesh review: capability coverage, independent review state, zone search/filter/isolation, quality histogram/range/extrema/probe/filtering, clipping section diagnostics, grouped parameters, readiness gates, and tests. Full 341-test web suite and production build pass.

title: Show all Project Drafts from every Resource
description: The Resource-mode Draft entry is currently filtered by the selected Resource source ID, making Project Drafts disappear on other Geometry, mesh, or Case pages. Make Draft discovery Project-wide while preserving stable source-ID navigation when a Draft is entered.
acceptance_criteria: Every Resource page displays the same total Project Draft count; opening a Draft navigates to its source Resource using the stable source ID; no Draft is hidden merely because the current Resource differs; empty Projects still show Create Draft; component/page tests and live browser verification pass.
close_reason: Made the Resource-mode Draft entry Project-wide, preserved stable source-ID navigation, updated tests, deployed, and verified Geometry and SurfaceMesh both show Drafts 3.

title: Add persistent compound mesh-quality filters
description: SurfaceMesh Mesh Quality needs reusable range-based triangle inspection. Users must combine multiple UVF scalar fields with AND/OR logic, see matching triangles outlined clearly in the 3D viewer, and retain the filter configuration per SurfaceMesh resource across visits.
acceptance_criteria: Mesh Quality exposes a filter panel with add/remove range rules, field selection, min/max bounds, AND/OR composition, enable/reset controls, and match count; matching triangles receive a high-contrast line overlay without hiding the base mesh; filters operate on generic UVF field data; configuration persists per SurfaceMesh resource and restores safely; React component/store/hook boundaries are reusable and tests/build pass.
close_reason: Implemented persistent per-SurfaceMesh compound quality range filters, generic UVF AND/OR triangle matching, high-contrast line overlays, match counts, reusable React hook/component boundaries, and regression coverage.

title: Support multi-gigabyte UVF visualization assets
description: Visualization assets can legitimately be multiple gigabytes. The current synchronization and serving path materializes each bin into Go byte slices and the browser fetches a whole ArrayBuffer, so merely increasing the 128 MiB limit is unsafe. Replace fixed small limits with configurable storage policy, stream cached assets with HTTP Range support, and avoid eagerly synchronizing every large LOD where possible.
acceptance_criteria: Server serves cached visualization bins with streaming and Range support without reading the whole file into memory; limits are configurable and default to an engineering-scale value or unlimited disk-backed policy; LOD assets are acquired on demand or persisted without byte-slice materialization; browser receives actionable handling for assets beyond practical WebGL memory; existing SurfaceMesh precision switching and tests remain green.
close_reason: Replaced fixed visualization byte limits with disk-backed persistence, default-LOD-first/on-demand LOD acquisition, streaming HTTP Range serving, and optional frontend deployment guards; added multi-gigabyte and on-demand regression coverage.

title: Implement T02 Project entry-path Web tutorial
description: Add the missing T02 tutorial that compares Geometry, SurfaceMesh, and VolumeMesh Project roots. Provide browser-native path comparison, validation-context teaching, user-selected mesh upload, Project creation, and two local Case Plans without cloud execution.
acceptance_criteria: T02 appears in the tutorial library and has a complete guided Web lesson; SurfaceMesh and VolumeMesh entry paths show skipped/required stages and validation implications; users can upload a supported mesh, create a Project, generate baseline/variant Case Plans, and navigate to review; tutorial artifacts account for both workflow capabilities; validators, Go tests, Web tests, and build pass.
close_reason: Added complete browser-native T02 root-path lesson, SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh upload environment builder, two Case Plans, validated tutorial artifacts, and tests; all quality gates pass.

title: Sync all UVF LOD buffers for precision switching
description: SurfaceMesh high-precision selection requests defaultBody.bin referenced by manifest LOD0, but local visualization sync only contains defaultBody_lod0.bin, causing a 404. Ensure preview synchronization and serving preserve every safe manifest-referenced .bin across all LOD levels, with bounded downloads and clear fallback behavior.
acceptance_criteria: All safe bin paths referenced by UVF buffers and LOD levels are synchronized or available on demand; high/default/low precision switching does not 404; existing cached manifests missing a level can repair on preview refresh; unsafe paths and download limits remain enforced; Go tests cover multi-LOD manifests and missing assets; frontend regression passes.
close_reason: Implemented all-LOD UVF synchronization, incomplete cache repair, and realistic buffer size limits; verified Go and web suites.

title: Reduce dense SurfaceMesh wire moire
description: SurfaceMesh Field=None can show camouflage-like moire when Wire is enabled on dense faces. Actual cached UVF inspection confirmed disjoint face ranges, separated periodic planes, and valid planar normals; the artifact is dense subpixel wire lines rendered at opacity 0.72. Make generic wire overlay intensity density-aware and preserve it through selection updates without changing fields or CFD semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Field=None with Wire off remains clean; Wire opacity decreases for dense faces while sparse faces stay legible; selection/material effects do not reset wire opacity to 0.72; CAD edges keep their existing opacity; tests cover density scaling and overlay persistence; full frontend tests/build pass.
notes: Verified against sm-9c4f4c31-239d-4aec-b530-d6836bc8b69a: LOD1 face00003 has 90,748 triangles at z=0 with mean normal +Z; face00005 is z=-4; ranges are disjoint. Fix wire moire, not geometry ownership.
close_reason: Verified the cached SurfaceMesh has disjoint face ranges, separated periodic planes, and valid planar normals; the camouflage was dense wire moire. Added triangle-density-aware wire opacity, preserved it through viewer selection updates, kept CAD edges unchanged, and added regression coverage. Full tests/build pass.

title: Recover tutorial Project imports when CLI omits root resource ID
description: T01/T03 Web environment creation creates the remote Project and Geometry successfully, but flow360 project create --sync returns only the Project ID. The server then marks the import failed before creating tutorial Plans, and retries can create duplicate Projects.
acceptance_criteria: After synchronous Project creation, the server resolves the root resource through a bounded project-items lookup when it is absent from CLI output; normalized import returns project_id and root_resource_id; tutorial Plans are created; tests cover the current CLI response; failures preserve actionable recovery context.
close_reason: Tutorial imports now reconcile root resources through project items, preserve partial Project recovery context, and navigate into the created baseline Plan; full Go and Web test suites pass.

title: Fix VolumeMesh fallback preview footer overlap
description: In VolumeMesh fallback preview, viewer stats/Wire controls and the Geometry spatial-context notice overlap in the reserved footer gutter, producing clipped text and excessive whitespace. Separate source provenance from viewer controls and keep both readable across responsive layouts.
acceptance_criteria: VolumeMesh fallback provenance does not overlap faces/edges/tris/Wire controls; footer height and positioning remain compact; source notice is readable without covering the canvas or inspector; SurfaceMesh/Case viewer controls are unaffected; tests cover fallback source presentation.
close_reason: VolumeMesh Geometry fallback now suppresses the duplicate in-viewer manifest warning while retaining contextual inventory and inspector messaging. Generic Viewer warning visibility remains opt-in configurable and defaults unchanged. Full tests/build pass.

title: Simplify Plan review evidence and stabilize monitor refresh
description: Remove implementation-centric Engineering evidence cards from the primary Plan review while preserving evidence in stored plan data, and keep the Execution Monitor refresh control visually stable during polling.
acceptance_criteria: Primary Plan review no longer shows redundant Engineering evidence cards; stored evidence remains unchanged; Refresh does not flicker into disabled styling during automatic or manual polling; duplicate refresh requests remain prevented; tests and build pass.
close_reason: Removed implementation-centric evidence from primary Plan review while preserving stored audit data; made live Refresh consistently disabled and available only when paused or terminal; all web tests and production build pass.

title: Fix release publication repository context
description: The publish=true Release workflow run 31075772037 built all four artifacts but gh release create failed because the assemble job has no checkout and gh could not infer a repository from .git. Explicitly provide the GitHub repository to all gh release commands and validate the real publish path.
acceptance_criteria: Manual publish=true workflow creates v25.10.3 GitHub Release with all four archives and SHA256SUMS; no ambient .git checkout is required.
close_reason: Fixed by setting GH_REPO explicitly for gh release commands. Formal publish run 31076253839 succeeded and created v25.10.3 with four platform archives plus SHA256SUMS.

title: Add manual Flow360-versioned release workflow
description: Provide a manually triggered GitHub Actions workflow that resolves the exact Flow360 version selected by the current init defaults, builds traceable Vibe Flow360 release binaries for supported Linux and macOS architectures, packages checksums, and publishes a matching GitHub Release.
acceptance_criteria: workflow_dispatch is the only trigger; exact Flow360 package version is resolved through the real init path; Linux/macOS amd64/arm64 archives embed and report that version; SHA256SUMS covers every archive; an existing tag/release is rejected safely; GitHub Release is created with tag and title matching Flow360; actionlint, local tests, and a manually dispatched dry validation pass.
close_reason: Implemented and pushed manual Flow360-versioned release workflow; GitHub dry-run 31068731585 passed with four v25.10.3 artifacts and checksum verification.

title: Scope Ask AI sessions to Resource or Draft context
description: Distinguish Ask AI sessions by active Resource versus Draft context while retaining Project-wide discovery. Each session must expose its primary context identity and allow the agent to inspect other Project resources and Drafts through bounded typed tools or equivalent context APIs.
acceptance_criteria: Resource and Draft conversations use distinct stable session identities; UI labels the current conversation scope; Draft sessions include draft and source-resource identity; every Project session can list and inspect other Project resources and Drafts without relying on display names; backend prompt/tool contracts and frontend tests cover the behavior; full tests, build, and browser verification pass.
close_reason: Implemented stable Project/Resource/Draft Ask AI scopes, Draft/source separation, Project-wide Resource and Draft context catalogs, UI scope labels, compatibility, tests, deployment, and browser verification.

title: Make Ask AI Convert to plans visibly complete
description: The Ask AI Convert to plans action appears unresponsive. Trace the action conversion endpoint and fix loading, success, error, and next-step presentation so users can see whether local plans were created and open them for review.
acceptance_criteria: Click immediately shows busy state; duplicate clicks are blocked; API errors are visibly rendered in the action card; successful conversions show created/failed counts and per-proposal outcomes; created plans can be opened in Plan review from the Ask AI panel; no Flow360 execution occurs; regression tests and production build pass.
close_reason: Convert to plans now shows in-card busy, success, partial-failure, and transport-error states; successful results open the created local Plan review; request context fills safe missing identifiers; proposal conversion is idempotent; affected Go/UI tests and production build pass.

title: Add init and serve commands to vibe-flow360
description: Turn the existing server entrypoint into an explicit serve command and add an idempotent init command that installs/pins required tooling, collects necessary configuration, writes .env safely, and verifies the runtime prerequisites so subsequent runs are reliable.
acceptance_criteria: vibe-flow360 init prepares required Flow360 tooling and configuration without destroying existing values; vibe-flow360 serve runs the backend; initialization reports actionable verification results; documentation and automated tests cover the workflow.
close_reason: Implemented idempotent init and explicit serve commands. Init bootstraps pinned isolated uv/Python/Flow360/CadQuery runtimes, preserves their paths for service reuse, merges a mode-0600 dotenv without destroying unmanaged content, supports official browser login/headless API keys, and verifies read-only Flow360 access. Documentation, unit tests, full Go tests/vet, 312 web tests, and production build pass.

title: Compact manifest visibility controls into one row
description: Render each manifest member group header on one line and replace separate Show all/Hide all buttons with one icon-only visibility toggle. Apply through the shared ManifestMemberGroup so Geometry, mesh, and case inventories behave consistently.
acceptance_criteria: Group header, visible count, and one bulk visibility icon stay on one row; the icon hides when any members are visible and shows when all are hidden; empty groups disable the toggle; accessible labels describe the current action; tests and localhost verification pass.
close_reason: Shared manifest group headers now use one compact row and one contextual visibility icon; Geometry and CAD labels remain unclipped and browser round-trip toggling passed.

title: Separate Draft Parameters modal from resource Details
description: Make the Project Draft Parameters action open a focused modal containing only active Draft parameters. Consolidate any unique resource information into the top-level Details panel so the two entry points have non-overlapping responsibilities.
acceptance_criteria: Parameters opens a focused parameters-only modal; Details retains resource metadata/status/summary/log content; no duplicate mixed-content Draft details panel remains; tests and localhost UI verification pass.
close_reason: Parameters now opens a focused parameters-only modal; unique active Draft metadata is consolidated into Details; full tests and localhost browser verification pass.

title: Flatten Draft controls and move Details to Project shell
description: The Draft compound popover adds an unnecessary layer for a small set of controls. The requested hierarchy is to show Draft switching directly in the second context row, expose Parameters beside it, keep Refresh compact, and move resource Details into the top Project action bar beside Resources.
design: Replace ProjectDraftBar popover state with a compact inline control group: Draft identity/icon, native active-Draft select, external Parameters button, and icon-only Refresh with accessible label. Remove Details from ProjectContextBar and add a ProjectShellAction immediately after Resources when a resource is selected. Preserve panel semantics, loading/disabled states, responsive behavior, and two-tier hierarchy.
acceptance_criteria: Draft switcher is directly visible without opening a menu; Parameters is a visible sibling action; Refresh remains available in compact form; Details appears in the top shell immediately beside Resources and opens the same resource detail panel; second context row no longer renders Details or a Draft popover; tests, build, and browser verification pass.
close_reason: Flattened Draft controls, moved Parameters outside, relocated Details beside Resources, and verified localhost layout

title: Compact Draft controls and keep Resources closed on entry
description: The unified two-tier Project resource header remains crowded because active Draft selection, Parameters, Refresh Drafts, and Details are rendered as parallel controls. Entering a Project also automatically opens the Resources overlay, obscuring the workspace. Consolidate Draft selection/status/actions into one compound dropdown and default Resources to closed.
design: ProjectContextBar renders one Draft compound trigger showing the active Draft name and status. Its popover contains the Draft switcher, status context, Parameters, and Refresh Drafts actions; resource Details remains a separate sibling. Tier 1 now contains the Project identity and Project-level actions; removed duplicate top-level Details. Tier 2 is a tested ProjectContextBar combining de-duplicated resource identity/status, simulation stages, compact active-Draft selector, Parameters, visibly named Refresh Drafts, and the single Resource Details action. Same-named Project/root resources render as '<Type> resource'. Verified 303/303 Vitest tests, TypeScript/Vite build, installed 9292 build, desktop screenshot, 680x844 responsive screenshot, exactly two DOM header tiers, and zero page/context horizontal overflow.

title: Add CFD display material presets for Geometry surfaces

Presets remain editable display records rather than physical boundary-condition assignments: choosing one changes visualization only and must not silently alter semantic boundary drafts. Existing persisted libraries are migrated additively without overwriting user-edited records or relinking surfaces by name. Surface association continues by material ID.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh and existing libraries expose all CFD presets; existing user edits and custom records survive migration; surface links remain stable across rename; presets can be bulk-applied through current selected-surface workflow; UI clearly distinguishes display material from CFD semantics; tests and production build pass.
notes: Implemented eight CFD-oriented visual presets: Wall, Farfield / Freestream, Inflow, Outflow, Periodic, Symmetry, Slip wall, and Porous jump. Added v2-to-v3 additive library migration that preserves edited seeded records and custom materials, while v3 continues to honor user deletions. Grouped presets in both material selectors and clarified that Display material is visual-only; CFD semantic assignments remain separate. Verified 300/300 Vitest tests, TypeScript/Vite production build, installed 9292 build, real v2 browser-library migration, all option labels, and Farfield color/opacity/safety copy.
close_reason: Geometry now provides tested CFD display presets with non-destructive migration and stable-ID surface associations.

title: Move AI Create into an English modal beside New project

title: Keep project annotations when local API fetch fails

design: ProjectAnnotationsController must retain the last successful project-scoped cache on same-project load/retry failures, keep stale annotations visible with an explicit error/stale state, and clear data only when projectId actually changes. Retry should set loading without clearing annotations or active draft. On first load with cached data, publish cached annotations immediately. Never fall back to browser localStorage: the source of truth remains the local Go annotations.Store under VIBESIM_DATA_DIR, scoped by environment/profile/projectId. Add tests for failure, retry, project switch and recovery; rebuild and restart 9292, then verify CRUD and restart persistence.
acceptance_criteria: After a successful load, a simulated Failed to fetch leaves annotation count and rows intact while showing retryable error; retry success replaces stale data and clears error; switching Project never leaks old records; fresh Project with no cache remains empty on failure; current local server exposes GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE annotation routes; an annotation survives server restart; Vitest, Go tests, build and browser validation pass.
notes: Implemented project-scoped stale-data retention in ProjectAnnotationsController: retry and fetch errors no longer clear annotations or active draft; cached target-project rows remain visible during refresh; success replaces stale data. AnnotationPanel distinguishes first load from background refresh and explains when last local-server data is shown. Verified 238/238 Vitest tests, TypeScript/Vite production build, Go annotations/store and HTTP handler tests, embedded binary on 9292, 5/5 records after restart, and real Geometry panel rendering. Local Go store remains source of truth; no browser localStorage added.
close_reason: Transient local API failures now preserve visible project annotations; local server persistence and recovery are verified.

title: Explain and unblock Plan compilation after AI fill
description: AI form fill may return missing-input questions while Compile & validate remains disabled with no visible reason. Make the compile prerequisites explicit, carry a useful AI intent into the plan, and ensure users can continue answering missing inputs without guessing why the primary action is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Compile button shows its exact blocking prerequisites; AI-generated proposal/intent updates the plan fields; missing-input responses clearly direct the user to answer and retry; tests and production build pass.
notes: Root cause: Compile & validate silently required Engineering intent, but AI prompt text was not propagated there; 6KB SimulationParams prompt cap also caused typical Case snapshots to be truncated. Fixed by deriving intent from the AI prompt, applying proposal intent, showing exact compile blockers/readiness, adding missing-input retry guidance, and retaining up to 48KB of SimulationParams context. Verified real browser transition disabled->enabled, no overflow, Go test/race/vet, 234 Vitest tests, and production build.
close_reason: Plan compilation prerequisites are now explicit and AI fill unblocks local compile validation while retaining complete typical Case context.

title: Fix Volume Mesh review layout collisions and duplicate panels
description: Resolve screenshot-reported Volume Mesh UI defects: stage connector overlaps labels, viewer source and toolbar overlays obscure the model, the built-in entity legend duplicates the left inventory, and readiness checks are clipped in the inspector.
acceptance_criteria: Stage labels remain unobscured; volume source context and controls do not cover the model; only the left region inventory is shown; all readiness checks fit the inspector width; focused tests and production build pass.
close_reason: Fixed stage connector label overlap, removed the redundant VolumeMesh viewer legend and source overlay, reserved a non-overlapping control rail for review viewers, and constrained readiness checks to one inspector column. All web tests, TypeScript, and production build pass.

title: 支持 Viewer 工具点位拖动与无吸附回退
description: 工具完成后的控制点应可拖动微调；当鼠标下方没有可捕捉几何特征时，仍应使用鼠标对应的三维点继续工具交互。
design: 扩展 picking hit 产生与 overlay 控制点交互；优先捕捉 vertex/edge/surface，未命中时使用相机射线与稳定交互平面求交；拖动更新草稿结果，保存后可进入编辑态并持久化更新。共享 Viewer3D 接口由协调者串行集成。
acceptance_criteria: 无 snap 候选时点击仍产生 fallback point；完成态控制点可拖动并实时更新结果；保存后 annotation 可重新编辑；不破坏 Esc/Enter/Backspace 与输入框保护；单元测试和真实 Viewer 验收通过。
close_reason: 无几何命中时以相机对齐交互平面生成 snap:none 自由点；完成态/保存态控制点支持拖动实时重算并通过 PATCH 持久化；真实 Viewer 自由点 Line 从 0.1644115 拖动到 0.1452217，相关测试、全量 build/Go tests 通过。提交 6d81d9c。

title: 优化 Annotations 可见性、筛选与列表密度
description: Annotations 列表需要明确的显示/隐藏状态、较紧凑字号，并支持按工具类型和所属资源筛选。
design: 在 Project Annotation panel 增加 All/Visible/Hidden 状态筛选、Tool 与 Resource 下拉筛选；每行提供可访问的 visibility toggle，压缩 typography/spacing，保留 focus/delete 能力。
acceptance_criteria: 每条 annotation 可显示/隐藏并有明确状态；按可见性、工具类型、资源组合筛选；列表字体和行高显著收紧；空筛选结果有清晰提示；组件测试通过。
close_reason: Annotations 增加 Visible/Hidden 状态与 toggle、All/Visible/Hidden + Tool + Resource 组合筛选、紧凑列表和无匹配提示；组件 5 tests 与真实项目列表筛选验收通过。提交 2ff2423。

title: 扩展 Viewer 几何工具集合
description: 在现有 Distance、Point、Line、Sphere、Polyline、Angle 基础上增加实用的 3D 标注与测量工具，并复用统一 ToolDefinition/Annotation/Overlay 架构。
design: 优先增加 Circle、Area、Box 三类可由点序列确定且能稳定保存/重放的工具；工具注册、几何结果、summary 与 overlay 保持数据驱动。
acceptance_criteria: Tools 工具条展示新增工具；每个工具可拾取完成、显示结果、保存并重放；相关 geometry/definition tests 通过。
close_reason: 新增 Circle、Area、Box，完成几何计算、结果校验、overlay、inspector、工具条图标和保存重放；相关 19 tests 通过，全量 build 与真实 Viewer 九工具验收通过。提交 063c98a。

title: 重构 Viewer Tools 工具条与右上角交互面板
description: 当前 Drawing and measurement tools 卡片将工具选择、状态、结果和保存操作堆在同一区域，视觉拥挤且破坏 Viewer 主次关系。将底部 Measure 入口改为统一 Tools 入口，按需展开所有注册工具；选中工具后在右上角独立 panel 完成提示、结果和保存交互。
design: Viewer 底部只显示 Tools launcher；launcher 展开紧凑注册工具条，覆盖 Distance、Point、Line、Sphere、Polyline、Angle。激活工具时保持单一模式，右上角浮层显示共享工具标题、拾取提示、结果、Save/Retry/Discard/Close；Workspace 不再直接渲染大型工具卡片。复用 ToolDefinition、useViewerTools/useDistanceTool 和现有 Project Annotation store，不向 Viewer3D 增加 tool-specific props。
acceptance_criteria: 底部 Measure 替换为 Tools；Tools 可展开/收起包含全部注册工具；选择工具进入独占模式并有明确激活态；右上角 panel 承担提示、结果和 Save/Retry/Discard；Distance 与五个基础工具均可用；键盘 Esc/Enter/Backspace 与输入框保护不回归；Geometry、SurfaceMesh、VolumeMesh、Case 的统一入口布局可用；相关 Vitest、build 和真实 Viewer 浏览器验收通过。
close_reason: 已将四类 Viewer 工作区底部 Measure 统一替换为 Tools launcher，展开 Distance/Point/Line/Sphere/Polyline/Angle 六工具并实现独占模式；右上角共享 panel 承担引导、结果与 Save/Retry/Discard/Close。验证：Vitest 46 files/226 tests、go test ./...、npm run build、make build、git diff --check、真实 Geometry Viewer 点拾取与模式切换均通过。代码提交 6536a1a。

title: 允许受限规模的多切片 VolumeMesh UVF 预览
description: 真实 VolumeMesh vm-911c1d77 的 37 个 SolidGeometry 各自引用低 LOD buffer，总 manifest 约 103 KB，却被 UVFLoader 的 maxBufferFiles=10 拒绝，导致 Distance 无法做真实浏览器验收。
design: 在保留单文件、manifest 和总体下载安全边界的前提下允许合法的多切片低 LOD 清单；增加文件数边界及总字节预算测试，禁止无界放宽。
acceptance_criteria: 37-buffer 真实形态可加载；超过文件数或总体字节预算仍被拒绝；UVF 单测、production build 和真实 VolumeMesh Viewer Distance 浏览器流程通过。
close_reason: Raised the bounded UVF file-count allowance to 64 while adding a 256 MiB aggregate budget, covered 37/65-file and byte-limit boundaries, moved the CFD toolbar out from under the decision panel, passed UVF tests and release build, and completed real vm-911c1d77 VolumeMesh Distance pick/save/overlay browser validation.

title: 以 Distance Tool 迁移 Geometry 和 SurfaceMesh Measure
description: 用新工具框架重新实现现有 Measure，作为端到端架构验证。先覆盖 Geometry 和 SurfaceMesh，移除两处重复的 measurementEnabled/measurementPoints 业务状态和 Viewer3D 的专用 Measure props。
design: 注册 distance ToolDefinition：exactly 2 points、surface pick policy、第二点自动完成。activate 后显示可访问引导；第一点后显示 marker、rubber-band preview 和 Select second point；第二点后停止 capture 并进入 complete-draft。结果计算 distance、deltaX/Y/Z、起终点、单位和 snap/entity 元数据。详情面板提供 Save、Retry、Discard；Save 写入当前 Project Store，成功后进入统一列表。Esc 取消，Retry 清空点但保持工具激活。不要在完成后第三次点击自动覆盖旧结果。保留旧 measurementDistance 测试作为计算回归，再删除重复 hook 状态。
acceptance_criteria: Geometry 和 SurfaceMesh 使用相同 Distance definition、runtime、overlay 和 Project list；第二点自动结束且不再改变实体 selection；详情显示长度和坐标分量；Save 后刷新仍存在且只在当前 Project 可见；Retry、Discard、Esc 和保存失败可恢复；旧 measurementPoints/onPickPoint API 被移除或标记为临时兼容且有清理任务；浏览器在两个真实 Resource 上验收。
notes: 迁移落点：GeometryWorkspace.tsx 的 measurementEnabled、measurementPoints、geometryMeasurementDistance、Measure toolbar 和 Inspection card；useSurfaceMeshAdvancedReview.ts 的 reducer actions 和 SurfaceAdvancedReview.tsx；Viewer3D.tsx 的 measurementPoints/onPickPoint props、measurementOverlayRef、overlay effect 和 handleClick 分支；LazyViewer3D.tsx 的专用 props。先兼容后删除时必须在同一 bead 内完成或明确记录 cleanup。
close_reason: Unified two-point Distance Tool now drives Geometry and SurfaceMesh through the shared runtime, picking, overlays, and Project annotation store; legacy measurement props/state are removed. Verified with 189 Vitest tests, production build, full Go tests, diff check, and real cached Geometry/SurfaceMesh browser flows covering auto-complete, result fields, Retry/Discard/Esc, save failure recovery, refresh persistence, and Project isolation.

title: 实现 Project Annotation 客户端状态与统一列表
description: 建立当前 Project 唯一的 Annotation 客户端数据源和统一管理列表。不同 Resource Workspace 复用同一个 hook 和 UI，但绝不加载其他 Project 的 Annotation。
design: 新增 api annotation methods、useProjectAnnotations(projectId) 和 AnnotationPanel。查询 key 必须包含 projectId；projectId 变化时 abort 旧请求、清空旧数据和 active draft，再加载新 Project。保存采用明确 saving/error 状态，可做 optimistic update 但失败必须回滚。列表显示 tool type、名称、来源 resource、摘要、可见状态和更新时间，支持 show/hide、focus、rename、delete、retry。列表是 Project 全量；当前 Viewer 只渲染由 ViewerContextCompatibility 判定为 compatible 的 Annotation，其余显示来源但不强行投影。Annotation 可见性是否持久化需统一：建议持久化用户设置。
acceptance_criteria: 切换 Project 时旧 Annotation 在新请求完成前也不会闪现；Project 列表 CRUD 和错误重试可用；当前 Resource 只渲染兼容坐标系的 Annotation；隐藏、聚焦、重命名、删除具备可访问名称和确认策略；API mock 测试覆盖竞态、abort、rollback、空态和跨 Project cache 污染。
close_reason: Added project-scoped annotation controller/hook, abort-safe loading, optimistic CRUD rollback, compatibility filtering, and accessible Project Annotation drawer; 186 Vitest tests, build, and real Project browser panel validation pass.

title: 建立通用 Annotation Overlay 渲染层
description: 用通用 OverlayPrimitive 渲染工具草稿和已保存 Annotation，移除 Viewer3D 内写死的 measurement overlay。第一阶段支持 point、polyline、label 和 sphere，且草稿预览和保存结果共用渲染路径。
design: 新增 ViewerOverlayLayer 或 useViewerOverlays 适配器，把领域层 OverlayPrimitive 转为 THREE.Group、Mesh、Line、Sprite 或 DOM label。Overlay 使用专用 Object3D group、renderOrder 和 layer；默认不参与 picking。统一处理 asset local 到 world transform、深度策略、颜色、透明度、线宽降级和单位标签。更新时按 annotation/primitive key 增量复用对象，删除和资源切换时 dispose geometry、material、texture。点尺寸和文字应采用屏幕可读策略，避免依赖模型绝对尺度；截图路径必须包含 Overlay。
acceptance_criteria: Point、两点线、N 点 polyline、球和文本标签可由数据驱动渲染；hover draft 和 saved annotation 可同时存在；显隐切换不重建 UVF asset；Overlay 不被 Picking Engine 命中；资源切换无残影；dispose、坐标变换、空 primitive、更新复用有测试；高 DPI 和截图浏览器验收通过。
close_reason: Data-driven point/polyline/sphere/label overlay layer is integrated into Viewer3D with keyed reuse, transforms, disposal, non-pickable layer, high-DPI labels, and capture inclusion; 8 focused tests, full web tests/build, and browser screenshot harness pass.

title: 抽取统一 Picking Engine 与 Viewer 输入仲裁
description: 把 Viewer3D 当前点击中的 raycast、实体选择、field probe 和 point pick 拆成统一 Picking Engine，使激活工具能够优先消费点击，同时保留相机拖动、实体选择和 hover。第一阶段交付可靠 Surface Pick 和丰富 PickResult。
design: 新增 buildPointerRay、pickScene、resolvePickCandidate 和 ViewerInputController。使用 THREE.Raycaster.setFromCamera；仅查询可见且属于 pickable layer 的 UVF Mesh，Overlay 放在独立 layer 并排除。Intersection 转为 PickResult：命中对象稳定 entityId、faceIndex、local/world position、插值或 face normal、resourceRef 和 coordinateFrame。用 pointerdown/up 的像素位移阈值区分 click 与 OrbitControls drag。输入优先级为 active tool、field probe、entity selection；工具消费事件时不得重新选择或重新聚焦实体。hover 只产生临时候选，不提交点。接口允许后续 Line、Points 和 snap resolver 扩展。
acceptance_criteria: 激活工具时单击只提交一次 PickResult，不触发实体 selection；相机拖动不提交点；隐藏实体、wireframe 和 annotation overlay 不可拾取；无命中时行为可配置；世界与 asset local 坐标转换正确；Geometry、indexed/non-indexed UVF Mesh 有单元测试；现有 selection 和 field probe 无回归。
notes: 实现调研：THREE.Raycaster.intersectObjects 返回按距离排序的 Intersection，并可通过 Raycaster/Object3D Layers 过滤对象；Line 和 Points 有独立 threshold，但其单位是 world units，因此最终 snap 体验必须换算为屏幕像素。参考：https://threejs.org/docs/pages/Raycaster.html ，https://threejs.org/docs/pages/Layers.html ，https://threejs.org/docs/pages/Object3D.html
close_reason: Unified surface Picking Engine and input arbitration are integrated into Viewer3D with drag suppression, tool/probe/selection priority, additive modifiers, coordinate/normal handling, and overlay exclusion; 12 focused tests, full web tests/build, and browser harness pass.

title: 实现 Project 隔离的 Annotation Store 与 CRUD API
description: 为 Viewer Annotation 提供 VibeSim 本地服务端持久化。Annotation 只属于一个 Project；列表、读取、创建、修改和删除都必须从 URL projectId 获取作用域，客户端 payload 不得覆盖归属。
design: 新增 internal/annotations 包和 Server 依赖，遵循现有 plans.Store 的 mutex、JSON、0600 文件权限和可重启设计。建议目录为 VIBESIM_DATA_DIR/annotations/<environment-profile-namespace>/<validated-project-id>/，每条 Annotation 独立 JSON 或使用带原子替换的 project JSON；优先独立文件减少整表写冲突。API 建议 GET/POST /api/projects/:project_id/annotations，GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/projects/:project_id/annotations/:annotation_id。创建时由服务端生成 annotation ID、projectId、createdAt、updatedAt；校验 projectId、annotationId 和 resourceRef，阻止路径穿越、跨 Project IDOR、未知 schemaVersion、超大 payload 和非有限数值。PATCH 使用白名单字段并保留归属与创建时间。定义 NotFound、Conflict、Validation 错误映射。
acceptance_criteria: Project A 无法通过任何 ID 读取或修改 Project B 的 Annotation；重启后数据存在；CRUD、空列表、坏 JSON、并发写、路径穿越、非有限坐标、错误 schemaVersion 和跨 Project 测试通过；API client 类型和错误处理齐全；磁盘权限和原子写符合现有 Store 约定。
notes: 本地实现参考：internal/plans/store.go 已提供 mutex、JSON 文件、重启恢复模式；internal/projectcache/store.go 与 internal/projectmirror/store.go 提供目录验证和命名空间参考；internal/server/server.go 从 VIBESIM_DATA_DIR 初始化 Store。Annotation Store 应独立成包，不写入 Flow360 remote metadata。
close_reason: Project-scoped Annotation store and CRUD API enforce IDOR isolation, strict validation, atomic 0600 persistence, restart/concurrency safety, and typed client errors; race tests, full Go tests, Vitest, and build pass.

title: 定义 3D Tool、Pick 和 Annotation 领域契约
description: 建立共享且不依赖具体 Workspace 的领域模型，替代 Viewer3D 的 measurementPoints 和 onPickPoint 专用接口。模型必须覆盖固定点数工具、不定点数工具、草稿会话、已保存 Annotation、资源锚点和坐标系。
design: 在 web/src/lib/viewer-tools 下定义只读 TypeScript 接口和判别联合：PickResult 包含 local/world position、projectId、resourceRef、entityId/type、triangleIndex、vertexIndex、normal、snap type/distance/confidence；ToolDefinition 组合 completion policy、PickPolicy、ResultComputer、OverlayFactory 和 InspectorDefinition；ToolSession 状态为 idle、armed、collecting、complete-draft、saving、saved、cancelled、error；ViewerAnnotation 含 schemaVersion、projectId、resourceRef、coordinateFrame、toolId、points、result、style、visible 和时间戳。使用纯 reducer 和纯计算函数。不要让持久化类型持有 THREE.Object3D、Vector3 或函数。接口优先，复用行为通过 createFixedPointTool 等工厂组合；除非证明有不可变生命周期模板，否则不引入 abstract base class。
acceptance_criteria: 类型可由普通对象实现；Distance 和 Polyline 的测试定义能共享运行时；reducer 覆盖 activate、pick、hover、undo-last、finish、cancel、retry、save success/failure；固定点数自动完成，开放点数仅在达到 minPoints 后允许 Enter 完成；序列化模型不含 Three.js 实例；单元测试覆盖非法状态转换和 schema version。
notes: 实现调研：TypeScript 使用结构化类型，普通对象只要满足 shape 即可实现契约；implements 只检查实例侧契约，不提供实现复用。因此优先接口、判别联合、纯函数和工厂组合，不使用深继承。React 官方建议 reducer 集中复杂状态转换。参考：https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/interfaces.html ，https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/2/classes.html ，https://react.dev/learn/extracting-state-logic-into-a-reducer
close_reason: Defined plain TypeScript tool, pick, session, overlay, and annotation contracts with shared fixed/open-point runtime; 9 focused Vitest cases and npm run build pass.

title: 建立 Project 级 3D 工具与 Annotation 框架
description: 将现有写死的两点 Measure 重构为 Geometry、SurfaceMesh、VolumeMesh、Case 共用的 3D 交互工具平台。Annotation 只在当前 Project 内共享和持久化，禁止跨 Project 读取、写入或聚合。
design: 采用 TypeScript 接口加组合，而不是深层类继承。核心契约包括 PickResult、ToolDefinition、ToolSession、OverlayPrimitive、ViewerAnnotation、PickPolicy、ResultComputer 和 OverlayFactory。React 侧使用 reducer 状态机；Three.js 侧保持命令式渲染适配器。允许提供很薄的固定点数工具工厂，但所有工具都必须能以普通对象实现接口。Project 是持久化隔离边界，Resource 和 coordinate frame 是标注锚点。
acceptance_criteria: 完成所有子任务后，Distance、Polyline 等工具可通过注册方式接入；Geometry、Mesh 和 Case 使用相同运行时；Project Annotation CRUD 严格隔离；拾取、键盘结束、Overlay、保存列表和高级吸附有自动化测试与浏览器验收。
notes: 调研基线（2026-08-03）：GeometryWorkspace.tsx 和 useSurfaceMeshAdvancedReview.ts 各自维护 Measure 状态；Viewer3D.tsx 同时写死 measurement overlay、raycast、selection、probe 和 onPickPoint；VolumeMeshWorkspace.tsx 与 CaseWorkspace.tsx 已复用 LazyViewer3D，但没有共享 Tool Runtime。架构目标不是 Measurement 专用层，而是 Picking Engine + Tool Runtime + Overlay Renderer + Project Annotation Store。
close_reason: All eleven planned and discovered child beads are closed; project-scoped annotations, shared tool runtime, Distance across four workspaces, registered drawing tools, topology-aware snapping, and final release QA are implemented and verified.

title: Make SurfaceMesh fill opaque and wire an overlay
description: Field=None still shows mottled/camouflage artifacts because default visible mesh materials are transparent, and wireframe currently replaces filled triangles. Make normal visible surfaces opaque unless an explicit appearance requests transparency, and implement UVF wire as independent line overlay so fill, field coloring, and wire coexist.
acceptance_criteria: Default visible UVF/SurfaceMesh materials render opaque with no back-surface transparency pattern; explicit appearance opacity still works; enabling wire preserves filled material and vertex field colors; disabling wire removes/disposes overlays; repeated toggles do not duplicate lines; tests cover overlay coexistence and cleanup.
close_reason: Default faces now render opaque unless explicit alpha/appearance opacity is provided, and wire is a disposable LineSegments overlay that preserves fill and field coloring.

title: Support arbitrary UVF precision level switching
description: Expose generic Viewer3D precision/LOD selection for UVF manifests with any number of levels. Support Auto/default plus explicit levels, reload only the selected buffers, preserve resource display state, and avoid SurfaceMesh-specific logic.
design: Precision selection is a generic Viewer/UVF capability. Undefined LOD means manifest default; explicit numeric LOD reloads only that level's buffers. The global selector exposes the minimum level count shared by all multi-level solids, while single-buffer solids remain unchanged. LOD 0 is presented as highest detail and the final common level as lowest. Same-asset switches preserve camera and reapply field, visibility, selection, clip, normals, appearances, and wire state.
acceptance_criteria: Viewer discovers UVF LOD count/default; selector is hidden for single-level assets; multi-level assets offer Auto and every available level; selecting a level reloads that level and reports loading/error state; existing field and visibility behavior remains valid; parser/loader and UI state tests pass.
close_reason: Added generic arbitrary-level UVF precision selection with manifest default, common safe levels, level-specific reload, camera preservation, state reapplication, documentation, and tests.

title: Do not auto-display SurfaceMesh fields

title: Keep 3D camera clipping stable across zoom

title: Diagnose 3D viewer disappearing during zoom
description: SurfaceMesh/geometry viewer can suddenly render nothing while zooming in or out. Determine whether camera clipping planes, controls limits, scene bounds, clipping state, or asset rebuilds cause the disappearance; report evidence before implementing a fix.
notes: Root cause found in Viewer3D camera lifecycle. fitPerspectiveCameraToObject sets near=max(0.001,distance-2*radius) and far=distance+4*radius once. OrbitControls defaults minDistance=0 and maxDistance=Infinity, and Viewer3D has no controls change listener to update near/far while dollying. After normalized asset fit, excessive zoom-in places the mesh at/behind the fixed near plane; excessive zoom-out puts it beyond the fixed far plane. The scene/asset is not unloaded. Explicit clipPlane is independent and only contributes if enabled.
close_reason: Diagnosed fixed camera near/far planes combined with unbounded OrbitControls dolly as the disappearance cause.

title: 修复 Schema 表单单位选择与模型级校验死路

acceptance_criteria: Quantity 单位使用选择器且提交格式仍为 value+units；无 loc 的 missing boundary condition 错误有可点击的修复入口；用户能添加覆盖相应边界的 boundary condition 并重新 preflight；未通过前仍不可审批/执行；包含 Go/React 测试、production build 和真实页面回归。

title: 实现 Flow360 Schema 驱动的动态 Preflight 表单
description:
问题：当前 Compile & validate 只检查 JSON merge patch 和粗粒度 source/target 兼容性，缺少真实 Flow360 SimulationParams 语义校验。用户可批准并提交不完整配置，直到 draft run 后才收到 Fail to generate simulation config，并暴露原始 Python traceback。

范围：
- 使用当前 Flow360 Python/flow360-schema 对 baseline + patch 按 source root type 和 target stages 做本地 preflight。
- 将结构化 validation errors 的 loc 映射到对应 Flow360 JSON Schema 子树，解析 ref、object、array、enum、union/discriminator、数值约束、默认值和 quantity/unit 元数据。
- 后端只返回缺失/错误字段所需的标准化动态 form schema、issues、当前值和 plan revision。
- 前端递归 SchemaForm 按 schema 生成输入控件；不硬编码具体 CFD 字段路径。
- 表单提交后服务端校验 revision，按路径合并值，重建最小 patch/diff，再次 preflight。
- preflight 未通过时阻止审批与执行；参数修改使已有审批失效。
- 将 traceback 收敛为可操作错误，原始诊断只进入 developer details/日志。

不包含：为每个 CFD 参数手写业务表单、绕过 Flow360 Schema、自行猜测缺失参数默认值、自动批准或发起付费运行。
design: Go 通过受控 Python subprocess 调用已安装 Flow360 SDK，继承现有 environment/profile/API-key 隔离、超时和输出大小限制。Python 输出版本化 JSON contract：valid、issues、form_schema。form_schema 是从 SimulationParams.model_json_schema 和错误 loc 投影出的最小 schema；前端使用 widget registry 递归渲染。提交 values 由服务端按 schema 重新验证并合并，不能信任浏览器类型。计划增加 revision/preflight 状态；审批绑定 revision，修改后回到 draft/needs_input。JSON Merge Patch 的 array 整体替换和 null 删除语义必须显式处理。
acceptance_criteria:
- 当前 ddd Geometry 运行到 Case 的空 patch 在远端提交前识别 surface_max_edge_length、boundary_layer_first_layer_thickness、velocity_magnitude 缺失。
- 动态表单由返回 schema 自动生成，不含这三个字段路径的前端硬编码。
- 支持基础 scalar、enum、boolean、quantity/unit、object、array 和 union 的递归渲染或明确 fallback。
- 用户提交值后生成嵌套 patch、刷新 semantic diff，并自动重新 preflight。
- required errors 未清零时 Approve/Submit 始终不可用。
- 修改已审批计划会失效审批并产生新 revision。
- API 拒绝 stale revision、非法类型、未知字段、超限 payload 和私有字段。
- UI 不直接展示完整 Python traceback。
- Go 单元/集成测试、React 测试、production build、diff check 和真实浏览器回归通过。
notes: 已完成：Go 受控调用本地 Flow360 SDK validate_model 与 SimulationParams JSON Schema，按目标阶段生成结构化 issues 和最小 form schema；计划持久化 baseline、revision、preflight，动态输入按 schema 服务端校验并 JSON Merge Patch 回 plan，修改自动失效审批并重新 preflight；新增 preflight/inputs API、payload 上限、stale revision/私有字段/类型门禁及 traceback 脱敏；React 新增递归 SchemaForm，支持 object、array、scalar、boolean、enum、quantity/unit、union 与 JSON fallback，preflight 未通过前禁用审批并隐藏远程提交。真实 ddd Geometry→Case 验收识别 3 个缺失字段，未提交猜测值。质量门：go test ./...、go test -race ./...、go vet ./...、安装 Flow360 schema 集成测试、39 个 Vitest、production build、git diff --check、ego-browser 回归全部通过。
close_reason: Flow360 Schema 驱动 preflight 动态表单、计划合并重校验和执行门禁均已实现并通过真实项目验收。

title: 进入 Project 时同步完整资源元数据到本地镜像
description: 问题：当前进入 Project 只分别读取 info/tree/items，并在用户选中资源后才缓存 resource-detail；本地没有按 Project ID 可观察的完整资源镜像，离线时也无法保证全部资源详情可用。范围：进入 Project 后启动一次有界并发的全量同步；获取 project info/tree/items，并为全部 Geometry、SurfaceMesh、VolumeMesh、Case 获取 info/state/summary/SimulationParams，Case 额外获取 results 清单；将同步状态、失败项、时间和数据来源持久化；同步完成前页面显示可恢复进度，完成后工作台统一优先读取本地镜像；支持手动刷新和重试失败项。边界：默认不下载大型 Case 结果二进制、Geometry/CAD、SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh 二进制资产；这些需要显式 artifact policy 和大小确认。
design: 新增 ProjectMirror/ProjectSyncService，目录按 VIBESIM_DATA_DIR/projects/<namespace>/<project-id>/ 组织，包含 manifest、project、tree、items 和 resources/<type>/<id>/detail.json。使用临时文件+atomic rename，目录 0700、文件 0600；并发数固定，单资源失败不覆盖最近成功快照；manifest 记录 expected/completed/failed resource IDs、started_at/completed_at/source/schema_version。HTTP 提供 sync status/start/refresh；ProjectPage 首次进入自动 start-or-join，避免 StrictMode/重复导航触发重复同步。现有 hash cache 可作为兼容 fallback，但 Project mirror 成为可检查的主存储。
acceptance_criteria: - 首次进入 Project 自动同步 project info/tree/items 和 items 中每个资源的完整 ResourceDetail。- Geometry/SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh 同步 info/state/summary/SimulationParams；Case 额外同步 results 清单。- 同一 Project 的并发进入只运行一个同步任务；刷新或重试不会破坏已完成快照。- .vibesim/projects/<namespace>/<project-id> 可直接看到 manifest 和按资源 ID 组织的 JSON 文件。- UI 显示总数、已完成、失败数、当前阶段、缓存时间，并允许重试失败项。- 某个资源失败时其他资源仍可用，旧成功数据不被空/非法响应覆盖。- 服务重启后能读取完整镜像；无效 API Key 时进入已同步 Project 可使用本地数据。- 不默认下载大型结果/网格/CAD 二进制；manifest 明确记录 artifact_policy=metadata-only。- Go 单元/并发/恢复测试、React 状态测试、ego-browser 在线同步与离线回退通过。
notes: Implemented ProjectMirror and asynchronous start-or-join ProjectSyncService. Entering a Project now blocks the workbench while syncing project info/tree/items plus every Geometry/SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh/Case ResourceDetail; successful snapshots are written atomically under VIBESIM_DATA_DIR/projects/<namespace>/<project-id> and mirrored into the compatibility hash cache. Added persisted progress/failure manifest, bounded 3-worker concurrency, old-snapshot preservation on partial responses, retry UI, and a stable Project route so default-resource navigation does not trigger a second sync. Validation: go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., 35 Vitest tests, production build, and ego-browser against production/default project prj-0106da10-1303-4881-b126-29f2ef343a5d. Real sync completed 9/9 (1 SurfaceMesh, 1 VolumeMesh, 7 Cases), generated 9 detail.json files, workbench stayed locked until completion, and server log showed one POST. Mirror size 308K; artifact_policy is metadata-only. Large CAD/mesh/result binaries remain explicitly out of scope.
close_reason: Full Project metadata synchronization, inspectable local mirror, progress/retry UX, automated tests, and real Flow360 browser verification completed.

title: 执行 Vibe Flow360 端到端发布验收 Gate
description:
问题：
各能力可以并行开发，但 Epic 关闭前需要一个只在所有交付物完成后执行的最终集成 Gate，验证跨模块契约、真实 Flow360 行为和产品承诺。

范围：
- 对照 Epic 和全部子 Beads 的验收标准建立最终矩阵。
- 运行 clean checkout/build/test。
- 使用真实 production/default 只读资源验证 Workspace、四类资源工作台、缓存和 AI context。
- 使用 fake CLI 验证 mutation、失败、幂等和重启恢复。
- 经单独明确授权后，执行一次受控非高成本 Flow360 创建/运行路径。
- 记录已知限制、证据和发布结论。

不包含：
开发未完成功能、默认触发计费运行。
design: 本任务是 completion gate，不是承载所有测试实现的桶；局部自动化由 .10 和各功能 Bead 完成。使用可复现命令、fixture、截图和远端 resource ID 形成证据包。任何真实 mutation 必须在执行当次再次获得明确授权。
acceptance_criteria:
- .1 至 .10 全部关闭且无未解决 blocker。
- clean 环境下 Go tests、React tests、production build、lint/diff checks 全部通过。
- ego-browser 完成 Workspace→Project→Geometry/SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh/Case、deep-link、cache fallback、AI proposal 和 plan approval 路径。
- fake CLI 完成成功、未授权、超时、部分失败、重复提交和服务重启恢复。
- 若执行真实 mutation，返回的 Project/resource IDs、状态和费用边界被记录；未授权时明确跳过且不伪造通过。
- 已知限制和 release/no-release 决策记录在 notes。
- Epic 的所有稳定验收标准逐条有证据后才关闭。
notes: 2026-07-29 gate update: code-level gates pass (Go tests, race, vet, golangci-lint; 45 Vitest; production build; diff check). Real production/default read-only smoke now includes ddd Geometry -> persisted invalid plan -> automatic Agent intervention and responsive modal. Release remains NO-GO because lf5.5, lf5.8 and lf5.9 require separately authorized remote mutations, lf5.10 still lacks its complete fake-CLI/accessibility matrix, and lf5.13 still requires CFD-owner confirmation of a real boundary proposal before apply/revalidation. No billable action was executed.

title: 完善上传导入与新 Project 创建流程
description:
问题：
现有 ImportPanel 能表达上传类型和计划，但文件与导入状态尚未形成完整持久化流程。刷新或服务重启后可能无法恢复，也缺少单位、大小、格式和重复提交的系统保障。

范围：
- Geometry、SurfaceMesh、VolumeMesh 文件上传。
- 服务端隔离 staging、元数据、hash、大小与 MIME/扩展名校验。
- Geometry unit 与 standard/catalyst workflow 确认。
- 生成 import plan、命令 preview、审批和执行。
- 重启恢复、失败重试、过期 staging 清理。
- 成功返回 Project/root resource ID 并导航到 Project。

不包含：
浏览器直接上传到 Flow360、未经审批执行、任意压缩包解压、通用文件管理器。
design:
上传使用流式大小限制和服务端生成 ID；原始文件名仅作为元数据，磁盘路径不使用用户输入。
文件存于 VIBESIM_DATA_DIR/imports/<id>，权限最小化，metadata/plan atomic write。
内容 hash 作为重复检测与 idempotency 输入；Flow360 CLI 只接收经过解析的绝对 staging path。
acceptance_criteria:
- 支持文档中列出的 Geometry/SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh 扩展名，错误类型明确拒绝。
- 上传大小受配置限制且不会把整个文件读入内存。
- 路径穿越、同名覆盖、符号链接和压缩炸弹路径不可利用。
- Geometry 未确认 units 时不能 approve/run。
- standard/catalyst 选择写入可审计计划。
- 页面刷新和服务重启后 staging/plan 状态可恢复。
- 重复提交和网络重试不会创建多个远端 Project。
- 成功响应包含真实 Project/root resource ID 并打开其深链。
- 失败保留可重试状态；安全清理不会删除活跃导入。
- Go 安全/持久化测试、React 表单测试和 ego-browser 上传回归通过。
notes: Import execution now normalizes nested Flow360 output and refuses to mark submitted unless both a real Project ID and typed root Geometry/SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh resource ID are present; the original typed CLI result is retained for audit. Existing atomic dedup/staging/unit/workflow gates remain. Tests cover valid nested IDs and missing-root rejection. Remaining before closure: separately authorized real upload/import lifecycle proving returned IDs and browser deep-link. No remote mutation was performed.

title: 加固 Flow360 审批执行、监控与重启恢复
description:
问题：
现有计划具备 draft/approved/running/submitted/failed 骨架，但需要验证真实 Flow360 CLI 各阶段、持久化远端 IDs、监控长任务，并在服务崩溃或重启后可靠恢复。

范围：
- 明确 project/draft create、simulation-params patch/set、run --up-to、wait/state/logs 命令映射。
- 每个 mutation 持久化 intent、commands、idempotency、timestamps、remote IDs 和错误分类。
- 防止双击、请求重试和服务重启造成重复远端资源。
- 重启时 reconcile running/submitted plans。
- run 成功后刷新 Project tree 并导航到新资源。
- 支持取消本地等待但不虚假声称取消远端计算。

不包含：
绕过 Flow360 CLI 的私有 API、自动批准费用、无法验证语义的通用命令执行。
design:
保持 immutable lifecycle 和 atomic file writes；执行前先持久化 attempt/idempotency record，再调用 CLI，再原子写回 returned IDs。
Go 启动时扫描 running/submitted plan，使用远端 state/resource IDs reconcile。
CLI adapter 返回 typed result/error，HTTP 层不解析 presentation text。日志中清除 API Key。
acceptance_criteria:
- 状态转换只允许 draft→approved→running→submitted/failed，并能表示 monitoring/terminal remote state。
- 同一 approved plan 的并发或重复 run 只产生一次远端提交。
- 每次成功 mutation 保存真实 Project/Draft/Geometry/Mesh/Case ID 与 solver version。
- CLI 超时、未授权、验证失败、网络失败和未知错误有不同可恢复提示。
- 服务在 run 中重启后能 reconcile，不把不确定状态直接标记 failed 或重复提交。
- 新资源出现后自动刷新 tree 并提供稳定深链。
- API Key 不出现在 plan、响应、日志和测试 fixture。
- fake CLI 集成测试覆盖成功、超时、重复提交、崩溃恢复和部分完成。
- 至少一次受控真实 Flow360 dry/low-risk 路径端到端验证。
notes: Implemented durable idempotency and restart reconciliation plus typed terminal monitoring continuation. Submitted plans now restart monitoring after process restart; reconciled plans immediately start monitoring. Monitor target is selected from the actual returned remote Geometry/SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh/Case ID instead of incorrectly reusing source type, and submitted is no longer stamped completed before terminal state. Fake-CLI/unit tests cover target selection and lifecycle; Go race/vet/lint pass. Remaining before closure: separately authorized low-risk real Flow360 mutation through terminal remote state and its resource IDs/tree refresh. No billable mutation was performed. 2026-07-30 real incident flow360-cli-e1q: plan-22e4cced4be80282 entered running with local submission_id, server restarted ~15s later before RunDraft result persisted, then name-only reconciliation could not find 'ddd · Surface Mesh'. Read-only Flow360 checks show no matching draft and Project contains only the source Geometry; older Untitled draft is unrelated, so this attempt created no visible remote resource and is safe to expose as retryable. Required fix: classify reconciliation_not_found separately from unknown; correlate with durable unique attempt token/remote IDs instead of display name alone; after bounded repeated draft+project-item absence transition to a reviewed retryable state; open Agent intervention for ambiguous candidates and never auto-resubmit.

title: 升级 AI Chat 为结构化仿真规划器
description:
问题：
当前 Chat with AI 能发送 resource context 和返回文本，但不能稳定表达缺失输入、参数来源、验证、semantic diff 或可审批动作。文本建议无法安全驱动 CFD mutation。

范围：
- 定义版本化 typed AI action schema。
- 支持 missing-input checklist、SimulationSpec、validation、parameter diff、branch preview 和 approval card。
- 对 provided/derived/inferred/defaulted 值保存 provenance。
- 服务端解析和验证模型输出，拒绝未知或非法 action。
- Chat UI 渲染交互卡片并把有效 proposal 转为 local plan。
- 所有执行继续经过 Plan approve/run API。

不包含：
让模型执行任意 CLI、绕过 deterministic validators、在模型上下文暴露 API Key。
design:
LLM 返回 JSON schema constrained action；Go agent service 负责解码、版本检查和转换为领域类型。
领域校验和 Flow360 compiler 不依赖 LLM。聊天文本是解释层，typed action 是执行层。
上下文按 Workspace/Project/Geometry/SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh/Case 分级并控制大小，引用缓存来源和 partial errors。
acceptance_criteria:
- 至少支持 create-plan 和 request-missing-input 两类版本化 action。
- 非法 JSON、未知 action、缺少字段和不兼容 source/target 被安全拒绝。
- 每个关键值携带 provided/derived/inferred/defaulted 来源。
- UI 展示 assumptions、warnings、semantic diff 和预计新分支。
- 用户必须显式转入 review、approve、billable confirmation 才能 run。
- 无远端 ID 时 AI 不显示已执行成功。
- AI context 与当前 route/resource 一致，切换资源不会沿用旧 proposal。
- API Key、完整环境变量和敏感本地路径不会进入模型 prompt。
- agent/schema/validator 单元测试及 chat ego-browser 回归通过。
notes:
相关关联：.2、.3 提供各资源 context，.5 使用 typed variation/sweep proposal，.8 执行已批准计划；这些可以并行定义契约，因此不设硬阻塞。

代码入口：
- internal/agent/service.go
- internal/plans/store.go
- web/src/components/CopilotPanel.tsx
- web/src/components/PlanPanel.tsx
先固化 action schema 和本地 fake-model fixtures，再接真实模型。
close_reason: Closed

title: 实现收敛与气动力可信度评估
description:
问题：
Flow360 Case 的 completed 状态不等于数值收敛，更不等于工程结论可信。当前 Convergence 标签禁用，用户只能下载文件后人工判断。

范围：
- 发现并读取 residual、force、monitor 等可用结果文件。
- 解析时间步/迭代、残差和 Cl/Cd/Cm 等曲线。
- 输出 converged、not-converged、insufficient-data 三态及证据。
- 展示趋势图、最后窗口统计、阈值、振荡/漂移提示。
- 将数值收敛与用户 KPI 稳定性分开。
- 为 AI 和 Case comparison 暴露结构化 assessment。

不包含：
通用科学可视化平台、未经验证的领域结论、仅凭 LLM 文字判断收敛。
design:
Go 层负责文件发现、格式限制、大小限制和结构化解析；确定性规则负责 assessment；React 只绘制数据与解释。
规则必须记录 input artifact、列映射、分析窗口、阈值和算法版本。无法识别时返回 insufficient-data。
优先支持 golden-path 外流场的 residual 与 forces CSV，再扩展其他格式。
acceptance_criteria:
- Convergence 标签可用并显示真实曲线或明确 insufficient-data。
- 至少支持一个真实 residual 文件和一个 force/monitor 文件格式。
- assessment 返回状态、原因、指标、窗口、阈值及证据文件。
- 残差下降但 Cl/Cd 漂移时不会错误判断为可信。
- 文件缺失、列缺失、NaN、过大文件和解析失败都有安全降级。
- 结论可被 CaseWorkspace、AI context 和 Compare 页面复用。
- 使用固定 fixtures 的 Go 测试覆盖收敛、未收敛、振荡和数据不足。
- 真实 Flow360 Case 的 ego-browser 回归展示一致。
notes: Implemented deterministic result discovery and convergence assessment. Flow360 case result listing tolerates CLI log prefixes/record envelopes, downloads canonical nonlinear_residual_v2 and total_forces_v2 into the Go data directory with 0600 permissions and limits, and safely falls back for missing/invalid data. CaseWorkspace and Convergence tab consume structured status/reason/metrics/window/threshold/evidence. Compare reuses assessment and Cl/Cd from total-forces history. Evidence: real production Case case-cefcc85c-4d72-4765-9252-2121c19f7421 rendered not-converged plus Cl=1.73848604459856 and Cd=0.180658986049835 from Flow360 total forces history; Results/Convergence tabs enabled. Unit/race tests pass.
close_reason: Real residual/force discovery, deterministic assessment, KPI evidence, UI and tests verified

title: 实现 Case 工作台与运行监控
description:
问题：
Case 是 CFD 工作流的核心，但当前仅有通用 metadata、logs 和 result artifact 列表，没有运行总览、操作条件、输出配置与可信度边界；用户也无法清楚区分 Running、Completed 和 Failed。

范围：
- 新增 CaseWorkspace。
- 展示 lifecycle、运行时间信息、operating conditions、reference quantities、solver/turbulence settings 和 requested outputs。
- 组织 Overview、Results、Logs；为 Convergence/Compare 提供明确入口。
- 非终态安全轮询，页面切换和组件卸载时取消或忽略过期请求。
- 结果文件的 preview/download/empty/error 状态一致。
- 支持创建 Case variation 计划入口。

不包含：
收敛算法与图表（.4）、多 Case 对比（.5）、Flow360 执行恢复（.8）。
design:
ResourceDetailPanel 可继续承载原始详情与 artifacts，CaseWorkspace 负责面向决策的摘要。
建立 normalized CaseViewModel，把不同 solver version 的 SimulationParams 与 summary 映射为稳定 UI 字段。
轮询复用 ProjectPage loadDetail，但使用 AbortController 或 generation token 避免 selected resource 切换后的陈旧响应覆盖。
acceptance_criteria:
- queued/running/preprocessing/completed/failed 等真实状态具有不同且准确的 UI。
- 非终态按配置周期刷新；同一资源不会产生重叠请求；离开页面后停止。
- Completed 只代表运行终止成功，页面不会自动显示 Converged。
- 操作条件、reference quantities、solver settings 和 requested outputs 可查看或明确缺失。
- result artifact 支持列表、文本/CSV 预览和下载；错误可重试。
- logs 支持 tail 切换、刷新、耗时和错误反馈。
- Case variation 只能进入审查计划，不能直接执行。
- cache fallback 仍可浏览最近完整 Case 状态和 artifacts metadata。
- 单元测试覆盖状态映射和轮询竞态；ego-browser 覆盖 completed 与 nonterminal Case。
notes:
相关任务：
- .2 是相邻的 VolumeMesh 工作台，可并行开发，不构成硬依赖。
- .4 真正依赖本任务提供稳定 Case context。
- .7 与 .8 会复用本任务的 context/monitoring 契约，使用 related 关联。

代码入口：
- web/src/pages/ProjectPage.tsx
- web/src/components/ResourceDetailPanel.tsx
- internal/flow360/client.go: ResourceDetail/ResourceLogs/ResourceResult
close_reason: Closed

title: 实现 Volume Mesh 专属工作台
description:
问题：
VolumeMesh 目前只能使用通用 ResourceDetailPanel，缺少计算域、网格规模、质量、region/boundary 及创建 Case 前检查，用户无法判断该体网格是否适合作为 Case 输入。

范围：
- 新增 VolumeMeshWorkspace 并接入 ProjectPage。
- 从 info/state/summary/simulation_params 中稳定提取 cell count、node count、质量指标、zones/regions/boundaries。
- 呈现 terminal/running/failed 状态与自动刷新说明。
- 就绪检查区分成功、警告、阻塞和 Not reported。
- 提供 Plan Case 主操作并复用 PlanPanel。
- Go snapshot 下保持可读并显示来源。

不包含：
真实 3D slice viewer（由 .6 提供）、Case 求解结果、直接绕过计划创建 Case。
design:
参考 GeometryWorkspace 与 SurfaceMeshWorkspace，但将字段提取整理为可测试的 normalize/select helper，避免只依赖单一 Flow360 版本字段名。
状态来自 state.status 优先、info.status 回退；未知字段显示 Not reported，不能推断虚假质量结论。
Plan Case 关闭 AI panel 后打开 PlanPanel，targetOptions 对 VolumeMesh 仅允许 Case。
acceptance_criteria:
- 选择 Geometry-root、SurfaceMesh-root 或 VolumeMesh-root Project 中的 VolumeMesh 都能显示工作台。
- 展示真实 cell/quality/domain 数据；缺失字段明确显示 Not reported。
- running 状态每 10 秒刷新，terminal 状态停止轮询。
- failed 状态显示可恢复错误和 Logs 入口。
- readiness 每条结论都能追溯到具体字段或缺失条件。

title: 扩展 Go 磁盘缓存到 Workspace 项目与 Folder 索引
description:
问题：
已访问 Project 的 info/tree/items/resource-detail 已写入 Go 本地磁盘，但 Workspace 的 folders 和 projects 列表仍要求 Flow360 在线。断网、鉴权失效或 CLI 短暂失败时，用户无法从首页发现曾使用过的 Project。

范围：
- 缓存 folder tree、全局 project list 和按 folder 查询的 project list。
- 使用 environment/profile 隔离命名空间。
- cache-first 显示后进行 live refresh。
- 展示数据来源、保存时间、失败回退原因。
- 定义 TTL、手动刷新、损坏文件隔离和安全清理行为。
- 合并多个已访问 Project 快照时保持稳定去重和排序。

不包含：
浏览器 IndexedDB、跨机器同步、缓存 Flow360 API Key、把缓存当作远端权威数据。
design:
扩展 internal/projectcache 的 allowed kinds 与索引能力；缓存文件继续使用 SHA-256 文件名、0700 目录、0600 文件和 atomic rename。
服务端为 /folders 与 /projects 复用统一 live/cache response headers。部分或结构无效响应不得覆盖完整快照。
WorkspacePage 只消费 API 的 source/cachedAt，不直接读本地文件。缓存清理必须限制在 VIBESIM_DATA_DIR/cache/flow360/<namespace>。
acceptance_criteria:
- 成功读取 folders/projects 后，重启 Go 服务仍能读取相同快照。
- 无效 API Key 下 Workspace 显示曾访问 folders/projects，并明确标识 Cached 和时间。
- 按 folder 与全局列表分别缓存，不串数据。
- production/default 与其他 environment/profile 数据完全隔离。
- 空响应、部分响应和非法 JSON 不覆盖最近完整快照。
- 缓存文件权限为 0600，目录为 0700，key 不能造成路径穿越。
- Go 单元测试覆盖持久化、fallback、namespace、损坏文件和失效策略。
- ego-browser 覆盖在线、重启和鉴权失败三种场景。
notes: Implemented Go disk cache for folder tree, global projects, and folder-scoped projects with production/profile namespace isolation, cache-first UI refresh, TTL/stale headers, retention cleanup, atomic permissions, and malformed/empty snapshot protection. Evidence 2026-07-29: online production/default loaded 167 folders; service restarted with FLOW360_APIKEY=invalid and the Workspace immediately rendered the same 167-folder snapshot with 'Cached 2026/7/29 12:04:01'; live refresh then logged Unauthorized without replacing the UI/cache. Go tests cover cacheability and store safety.
close_reason: Go disk cache and online/restart/invalid-key browser fallback acceptance verified

title: Vibe Flow360 Web：完成端到端 Flow360 仿真工作流
description:
问题与目标：
当前 VibeSim 已具备真实 Workspace、Project resource tree、Geometry/SurfaceMesh 初版工作台、Go 磁盘快照和本地审批计划，但尚未形成从输入到可信结果的完整闭环。本 Epic 管理后续所有跨会话工作。

包含范围：
1. Workspace 离线可用与持久缓存。
2. VolumeMesh、Case 和结果可信度工作台。
3. Case 对比、变体与 sweep。
4. Geometry/Mesh 真实 3D 可视化。
5. AI 结构化规划、显式审批和 Flow360 执行恢复。
6. 上传导入、大型 Project 性能、可访问性与端到端验证。

不包含：
优化器、DOE、组织级策略、多租户权限和非外流场领域包，除非后续单独创建 Bead。
design:
产品基线：docs/product-brief.md 与 docs/ux-architecture.md。
架构约束：
- Project-first，resource selection 决定工作台和 AI context。
- LLM 只解释意图和产生结构化 proposal，不直接调用 Flow360。
- 所有 mutation 使用 typed endpoint、确定性校验、semantic diff 和 explicit approval。
- Go 服务拥有凭证、磁盘状态与缓存；浏览器不保存 Flow360 API Key 或权威业务状态。
- Completed、Converged、Credible 是三个不同判断。
acceptance_criteria:
- Workspace 到 Project/resource 的深链可恢复。
- Geometry → SurfaceMesh → VolumeMesh → Case 支持分支而非虚构线性流水线。
- 用户能审查参数来源、验证、风险和预计影响后再执行。
- Flow360 执行返回并持久化真实 resource ID，重启后可恢复。
- Case 页面分别呈现运行完成、数值收敛和结果可信度。
- 在线失败时已读取资源可从 Go 本地快照继续浏览。
- 所有子 Beads 完成且 Epic 端到端验收通过后才能关闭。
notes: 当前基线：Go backend: internal/server, internal/flow360, internal/plans, internal/projectcache；React: WorkspacePage, ProjectPage, ResourceDetailPanel, PlanPanel, CopilotPanel。已完成真实 folder/project navigation、resource tree、四阶段工作台基础、计划审批、缓存、动态 preflight 与 Agent recovery。2026-07-31 产品优先级确认：先完整跑通 Project/资源选择→Run up to 动态阶段参数→Agent 补全→preflight→审查批准→draft run→远端监控→结果/失败恢复的核心闭环；Flow360 CLI 管理命令的全面封装延后，不阻塞核心闭环和发布 Gate。

title: 基于 Flow360 源码规划时序切片播放器大文件优化
description: 检查 Flow360 SDK/CLI 的 Case 结果对象列表、S3 元数据、Range 读取和下载实现，并结合 VibeSim 当前下载、扫描、转换、缓存与首帧发布链路，形成跨仓库分阶段优化计划；本任务仅调研和规划，不修改实现。
notes: Flow360 源码与生产只读探测结论（2026-08-17）：CaseWebApi.list_files() 只返回资源对象列表，slices 为单一 results/slices.tar.gz，成员帧没有独立对象。S3TransferType._get_s3_sts_token() 可取得按 Case 文件授权的 S3/OSS 客户端；read_bytes() 已支持 Range，但会把请求范围一次性读入内存；download_file() 先 head_object 获取 ContentLength，随后用 boto3 client.download_file，只支持 exists+overwrite/skip，没有稳定 partial、ETag 校验或跨进程 resume。CLI case results get 只暴露 --output/--overwrite。生产 Case case-bb54... 对 results/slices.tar.gz 做 1 byte 探测返回 Accept-Ranges=bytes、Content-Range=bytes 0-0/8436478895、gzip 首字节 0x1f；HEAD 返回 ContentLength=8436478895、ETag="baca41...-252"、LastModified=2026-08-15T18:16:01Z。该 multipart ETag 不能当内容 MD5，但可作远端对象身份/If-Match 校验。真实归档开头为大量 PVTU manifest，支持在同一 tar pass 中先建立 piece->frame 映射、随后转换 VTU。优化计划：阶段1 Flow360 SDK 新增流式可恢复下载（stable .part + sidecar remote path/ContentLength/ETag/LastModified，HEAD 前置 max_bytes，GET Range bytes=<part>- + IfMatch，chunked write，fsync+atomic rename，失败保留 part），CLI case results get 增加 --resume/--max-bytes/机器可读进度；阶段2 VibeSim 将 archive blob 按 source fingerprint 持久化并跨 job/restart/singleflight 复用，移除 job 目录 defer 删除，启动时恢复任务；阶段3 合并 ScanTarGz+ConvertTarGz 为单 pass，保留安全限额，并在 expected PVTU pieces 齐全时原子发布 frame；阶段4 前端支持 partial_ready、available frames 和增量元数据，首帧可播后后台继续；阶段5 拆分 source/index/converter/UI schema cache version，取消未消费 preview 或改成真正 preview-first；可选阶段6 CLI raw stream/tee 让下载与转换流水线重叠。验收重点：500MiB 中断后 Range 从 500MiB 继续；完整 blob 重启零网络重下；冷准备压缩流读取接近 1x 而非 2x；元数据/UI 版本升级不重下载/重转换；最大尺寸在下载前拒绝；不将大 Range 一次性放入内存。
close_reason: 已完成 Flow360 SDK/CLI 源码追踪、生产 Range/HEAD 只读验证，并形成跨 Flow360 与 VibeSim 的分阶段优化计划。

title: 调研时序切片播放器大文件准备性能
description: 分析 Case 时序切片/表面播放器对大 tar.gz 结果归档的下载、扫描、转换、缓存和首帧展示链路，识别主要耗时与 I/O 放大，并形成可落地的分阶段优化建议；本任务仅调研，不修改播放器实现。
notes: 现场证据（2026-08-17）：当前 Case slices.tar.gz 为 8,436,478,895 bytes。任务 4e5... 11:10:11Z 创建，文件 11:18:53Z 下载完成（约 8分42秒，约16 MB/s），11:21:57Z 服务重启前已到 72%，说明完整扫描约3分钟；重启后 Store 将任务标 failed，完整归档仍留在 job 专属 downloads 目录但不会复用。重试 5d6... 从零下载，约3分43秒仅 500 MiB，服务重启后再次失败。代码链路为完整下载 -> ScanTarGz 完整 gunzip/tar 遍历 -> ConvertTarGz 再次完整 gunzip/tar 遍历 -> 所有帧完成后一次性发布；首帧不可提前播放。cache key 将 IndexVersion、Case、path、size 绑定，Web/元数据版本升级也会让相同源文件重新下载/转换；同一 849,425,758-byte 归档 v4 用约2分03秒，v5 因版本键变化再次全量准备且约15分29秒。预览生成还会对每个大 piece 再扫描 indices、positions 和每个字段，但当前 Web 始终选择 full manifest，预览产物未用于播放。建议优先级：P0 将下载 blob 按 source fingerprint 持久化、校验大小/ETag 后跨 job/重启复用，并在能力允许时用 HTTP Range+If-Range 续传；P0 合并扫描与转换为单次 gzip/tar pass；P0 保存转换 checkpoint 并按完整 frame/timestep 渐进发布，首帧可用后即进入播放器，后台继续；P1 分离 archive/index/converter/UI schema 版本，避免 UI/metadata 变更清空大资产缓存；P1 增加 download bytes、converted frames、吞吐与 ETA；P1 评估取消未消费的 preview 或改为真正的 preview-first；P2 上游改为 manifest+per-frame/chunk objects/VTKHDF 等可随机访问产物。未来 Case 可通过提高 SliceOutput frequency、设置 frequency_offset、减少字段和切片数量控量。
close_reason: 已完成真实 8.44 GB 归档现场诊断、代码链路分析、历史耗时对比和分阶段优化建议；本任务按用户要求仅调研，不修改播放器实现。

Automated: 45/45 Vitest files and 223/223 tests pass; make build passes TypeScript/Vite and embedded Go release build; go test ./... passes; go test -race ./internal/annotations ./internal/server passes; git diff --check passes. Save-failure recovery was exercised by returning a rejected Geometry draft to draft and successfully resaving after schema integration. Screenshot evidence captured in the in-app browser for saved VolumeMesh overlay and status chip; temporary E2E annotations were precisely removed. Performance/resources: snap guards run at 100,000 and 1,000,000 triangles with a 2,000-triangle feature-scan degradation limit and <100 ms regression threshold; repeated 100-resource overlay switches keep one live object and dispose all 100 geometries/materials; UVF accepts 37 files but rejects 65 and enforces 25 MiB/file plus 256 MiB aggregate.
