title: 实现 Mesh Vertex、CAD Edge、CAD Vertex 和特征点吸附
description: 在基础 Surface Pick 上增加可扩展 SnapResolver，支持 Mesh Vertex、CAD Edge、CAD Vertex，以及凸点、凹点、锐角等 feature point 候选，并向用户明确显示吸附类型和置信度。
design: SnapResolver 接口接收基础 Intersection、ViewerContext、camera 和 screen position，返回按 screen-distance、tool policy、topology confidence 排序的候选。Mesh Vertex：从命中 triangle 的 BufferGeometry index 或连续 position 取得三个 vertex，转换到世界和屏幕坐标，用像素阈值而非固定世界阈值；保留 vertexIndex。CAD Edge/Vertex：优先使用 UVF manifest/topology 中稳定 edge/vertex ID；Edge 可用 THREE.Line raycast threshold 产生候选，但最终阈值按屏幕像素校正。Feature point：Geometry 优先 CAD topology 和曲率；Mesh fallback 用相邻面法向、二面角或 angle deficit 分类 convex、concave、sharp，并记录 method/confidence，避免把 tessellation 噪声当 CAD 特征。Tab 循环重叠候选，Alt 临时禁用 snap，状态 chip 显示 SURFACE、EDGE、VERTEX、CONVEX 等。大模型如性能不足，先 profiling 再评估 BVH；不要在无数据证据时直接引入新依赖。
acceptance_criteria: indexed/non-indexed Mesh Vertex 吸附和 vertexIndex 正确；缩放相机后像素容差体验稳定；CAD Edge/Vertex 使用稳定 ID；凸凹分类说明来源和 confidence；Tab、Alt、tool pick policy 和 candidate indicator 可用；隐藏实体和 Overlay 不产生候选；密集网格性能有基准和降级策略；算法单测及真实 Geometry/SurfaceMesh 浏览器验收通过。
notes: 实现调研：THREE.BufferGeometry 的 index 表示 indexed triangle 的三个 vertex index；没有 index 时每三个连续 position 构成 triangle。通过 getIndex、getAttribute(position) 和 Vector3.fromBufferAttribute 取得命中 face 的候选 vertex，再投影到屏幕比较像素距离。参考：https://threejs.org/docs/pages/BufferGeometry.html ，https://threejs.org/docs/pages/BufferAttribute.html。凸凹特征必须优先真实 CAD topology；网格法向算法只作为带 confidence 的 fallback。
close_reason: Added topology-aware SnapResolver with screen-space thresholds, CAD and mesh candidates, stable snap metadata, Tab cycling, Alt bypass, status/preview UI, benchmark guard, backend persistence support, unit coverage, and real SurfaceMesh/Geometry viewer validation.

title: 增加 Point、Polyline、Line、Sphere 和 Angle 工具
description: 验证工具框架不只服务 Distance：用注册方式增加一个点、两个点、三个点和不定点数工具，不修改 Viewer3D 的核心点击流程。
design: 实现 Point Marker：1 点自动完成；Line：2 点自动完成，仅几何对象；Sphere：2 点，第一点为 center、第二点定义 radius；Polyline：min 2、无 max，Enter 或双击完成，显示每段和累计长度；Angle：3 点，以第二点为顶点计算 0 到 180 度夹角。所有工具复用 PickResult、runtime、OverlayPrimitive、details 和 Project Store。开放点数工具支持 Backspace 删除最后一点、Enter 结束、Esc 取消；不足 minPoints 时 Enter 不完成并给提示。数值计算使用纯函数，处理零长度、重复点和非有限值。
acceptance_criteria: 五个工具无需向 Viewer3D 添加 tool-specific props；Point、Line、Sphere、Polyline、Angle 的计算与序列化测试通过；Polyline 可用 Enter 和双击完成并可 Backspace；每个工具的 draft preview、Save/Discard、列表摘要和重新加载渲染可用；键盘事件不会在输入框中误触发。
close_reason: Added registered Point, Line, Sphere, Polyline, and Angle annotation tools with shared hook/panel, exclusive tool activation, completion/edit keyboard behavior, persistence through project annotations, unit coverage, and real Geometry interaction/save validation.

title: 把共享 Tool Runtime 接入 VolumeMesh 和 Case
description: 让 VolumeMesh 和 Case 使用与 Geometry、SurfaceMesh 相同的工具运行时、Project Annotation 列表和 Distance 工具，同时明确不同资源和 fallback Geometry 之间的坐标兼容规则。
design: 为每个 Workspace 构造 ViewerContext：projectId、resourceRef、assetRef、coordinateFrameId、unit、capabilities 和 compatibility resolver。coordinateFrameId 应由稳定 asset/transform/lineage 信息生成，不依赖显示名称。Case 使用 Geometry fallback 时可以声明与来源 Geometry frame compatible；真实 solution mesh、slice 或变形网格只有 frame 明确匹配时才渲染旧 Annotation。Project 列表始终可查看全部记录，但不兼容项显示 Not available in current view。工具入口、提示、快捷键和结果详情复用共享组件，Workspace 只提供 capability 和单位。
acceptance_criteria: 四类 Workspace 都能启动 Distance 并保存到同一 Project 列表；切换资源不会泄漏 active draft；兼容 frame 正确显示 annotation，不兼容 frame 不错误投影；Case fallback 行为有测试；单位和 resource source 正确；无重复 Measure reducer 或 overlay 实现。
close_reason: Distance tool extended to Geometry, SurfaceMesh, VolumeMesh, and Case workspaces with owning-resource/coordinate-frame separation, resource-keyed remount isolation, compatible geometry fallback, and workspace tests; full Go/Web suites and build passed, with real Case save/source validation.

title: Add P1 Geometry inspection and CFD semantics tools
description: Extend the P0 Geometry review workspace with measurement, clipping, normal inspection, boundary and body-role assignments, unassigned-surface workflow, issue-to-3D focus, and reviewable AI suggestions with undo and diff.
design: Build on Viewer3D measurementPoints, clipPlane, focusTarget and selection APIs. Persist semantic drafts locally and pass them through the agent plan and approval protocol before remote execution.
acceptance_criteria: Users can inspect and measure geometry, assign CFD semantics to selected entities, locate issues in 3D, and review changes before they affect a meshing plan.
close_reason: Implemented and verified Geometry inspection, CFD semantic drafting, 3D issue focus, and auditable Plan evidence flow.

title: SurfaceMesh 高级审查：版本对比、裁剪测量与 AI 修复建议
description: 在基础 SurfaceMesh 工程审查闭环完成后，增加两个 SurfaceMesh 的参数/质量对比、clipping 与测量、截图导出，以及基于选中问题区域生成可审查参数 patch 的 AI 工作流。
design: 对比和 AI 建议只消费通用 UVF field/entity API 与 SurfaceMesh 业务 adapter；AI 不直接修改或提交远端资源，仍走参数 diff、preflight 和明确审批。
acceptance_criteria: 可比较两个 SurfaceMesh 的参数与质量分布；可裁剪/测量/导出视图；从选中异常区域生成带证据的参数 patch 并进入现有审批流程。
notes: Implemented same-Geometry SurfaceMesh parameter and UVF quality histogram comparison; reusable Viewer3D clipping, point measurement, and PNG capture; evidence-backed remediation recommendations that create a draft plan and open the existing preflight/approval flow. Verified with 20 Vitest files / 99 tests, production TypeScript/Vite build, and git diff --check.
close_reason: Acceptance criteria implemented and verified: compare, clip/measure/export, and evidence-backed remediation plan approval flow.

title: Wireframe toggle does not expose pressed state
description: The Geometry/Surface Mesh viewer's 'Toggle wireframe overlay' button changes only its CSS class from 'viewer-wireframe-toggle' to 'viewer-wireframe-toggle active'. It has an accessible name but aria-pressed remains absent before and after activation, so assistive technology cannot determine whether wireframe is on or off.
acceptance_criteria: The toggle exposes aria-pressed=false/true in sync with visual state; keyboard activation works; component/a11y tests verify both states.
notes: Viewer wireframe toggle now binds aria-pressed to wireframeOn. ego-browser verified false before activation and true after activation on the real Geometry page.
close_reason: Implemented, covered by automated tests/build, and verified on the real Geometry page with ego-browser.

title: Plan panel typography is unreadably small
description: On a 1440x775 desktop viewport, computed font sizes in the Plan panel range from 5px to 16px. Of 61 sampled text/form elements, 38 are below 10px and 40 are below 12px. Examples: LOCAL PLANS 6px, resource context 7px, field labels 8px, plan name/select/textarea 9px. This makes the multi-stage parameter workflow difficult to scan and edit.
acceptance_criteria: Plan labels, controls, descriptions, stage summaries, and validation text use a readable, consistent type scale at supported breakpoints; no primary form/control text is rendered at 5-9px; visual regression coverage protects desktop and mobile layouts.
notes: Introduced a Plan-specific readable type scale: metadata 11px, form/body 12-13px, stage headings 14-16px, and widened history to 260px. ego-browser at 1440x775 measured 61 Plan text/control elements: min 11px, 0 below 10px (previously min 5px and 38 below 10px).
close_reason: Implemented, covered by automated tests/build, and verified on the real Geometry page with ego-browser.

title: Plan stage JSON validation corrupts SyntaxError message
description: Reproduction: open Geometry Plan; enter a valid plan name/engineering intent; put '{' in a stage SimulationParams patch; click Compile. Actual: UI shows 'Invalid SimulationParams patch: SyntaxExpected property name or '}' in JSON at position 1 ...'. The 'SyntaxError: ' prefix is partially removed because generic string replacement removes the substring 'Error: ' inside 'SyntaxError:'. Expected: a grammatical validation message that preserves the error type or cleanly removes the full prefix.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid JSON never renders 'SyntaxExpected'; the message reads naturally (for example 'Invalid SimulationParams patch: Expected property name...'); regression coverage includes a native SyntaxError message.
notes: Fixed PlanPanel validation copy with a shared errorMessage helper that reads native Error.message and only strips a leading Error prefix from string values. Added native SyntaxError regression coverage. Real-page verification: invalid '{' renders 'Invalid SimulationParams patch: Expected property name or '}' ...' with no SyntaxExpected corruption.
close_reason: Implemented, covered by automated tests/build, and verified on the real Geometry page with ego-browser.

title: QA Geometry project workbench with ego-browser
description: Exploratory interaction testing of the Geometry resource workbench at the supplied local project URL, covering desktop/mobile responsive behavior, Resources, Details, Plan Run up to stages, 3D viewer controls, and Simulation Copilot.
acceptance_criteria: All tested paths and reproducible findings are recorded as linked issues; QA task is closed with a concise result summary.
notes: Completed ego-browser QA at desktop 1440x775 and mobile 390x844. Passed: Geometry render on fresh desktop/mobile load; resource tree navigation to SurfaceMesh; Details drawer; Plan Run up to dynamic stage expansion (Surface Mesh, Volume Mesh, Case); invalid stage JSON blocks compilation; Ask AI opens in resource context; wireframe visual toggle. Findings filed: flow360-cli-qk8, flow360-cli-kxm, flow360-cli-43m, flow360-cli-a7s, flow360-cli-3he. No console error was observed in drained browser events.
close_reason: Closed

title: Ignore generated server dist and local vibe-flow360 artifact
description: Add internal/server/dist and root vibe-flow360 to .gitignore, and stop tracking existing dist outputs without deleting local files.
acceptance_criteria: Both paths are ignored; internal/server/dist is absent from the Git index; unrelated working-tree changes remain untouched.
close_reason: Added root-anchored ignore rules and removed generated server dist from the Git index while retaining local artifacts.

title: 大型 Project 性能、可访问性与端到端回归
description:
问题：
功能扩展后需要验证真实大型 Project、窄屏、键盘操作、请求竞态和错误状态。零散单元测试不足以防止首页按钮、深链、缓存和审批流程回归。

范围：
- 100+ Cases 的 resource tree 性能与默认折叠策略。
- 搜索、type/status filter、Case grouping/flat view。
- 键盘焦点、ARIA、dialog、窄屏 sidebar/inspector/AI/plan overlay。
- Go、React、ego-browser 分层测试矩阵。
- online、cache-only、live fallback、partial error、deep-link、approval、restart recovery。
- 性能基线和可观测日志。

不包含：
替代所有人工 CFD 验证、第三方浏览器全矩阵、无上限性能承诺。
design:
建立 deterministic fixtures 与 fake flow360 CLI；少量真实线上项目用于 smoke test。
resource tree 对大集合使用折叠、虚拟化或分页，但 URL/resource selection 保持权威。
E2E 不执行 billable mutation，除非测试用例获得单独明确授权。
acceptance_criteria:
- 100+ Cases 项目首次渲染不全展开，搜索/选择保持可交互并有可记录性能基线。
- resource deep-link 刷新、前进、后退保持选中项。
- 所有可见按钮可用、隐藏或带明确禁用原因，不存在 no-op。
- 键盘可到达核心操作；dialog 有 focus 管理；窄屏无不可恢复遮挡。
- online、Go cache fallback、partial response、invalid key 和 restart 场景都有回归。
- plan review/approve/run 的非计费测试验证双提交保护。
- Go tests、React tests、build、diff check 和 ego-browser suite 可重复通过。
- 日志能定位 CLI duration/cache source/error class 且不泄露密钥。
- bd preflight/lint 无 orphan 或依赖循环。
notes: Added a deterministic 500-Case tree indexing/collapsed-render performance baseline and intervention selection/polling regressions. ego-browser on real production/default verified the plan recovery entry, visible desktop modal, plan-bound intervention polling, and 390x844 mobile layout with zero horizontal overflow. All Go tests, race, vet, golangci-lint, 45 Vitest and production build pass. Remaining before closure: full fake-CLI online/cache/partial/invalid-key/restart matrix and broader keyboard/deep-link suite as specified.

title: 建立 Geometry 与 Mesh 3D 可视化基础设施
description:
问题：
Geometry、SurfaceMesh 和 VolumeMesh 工作台目前以文本指标为主，无法直观看到几何、surface zones 或 volume domain。需要一个可复用、受控的大模型资产 viewer 基础。

范围：
- 调研 Flow360 CLI/API 可获取的 preview/mesh 格式。
- 后端提供受限、可缓存、可取消的 preview endpoint 或转换管线。
- React viewer 支持 orbit/pan/zoom、fit view、选择、可见性和颜色图例。
- Geometry groups、SurfaceMesh boundaries、VolumeMesh regions 使用同一选择模型。
- 加载、进度、空、错误和大文件降级。
- 定义 viewer 与 Inspector/AI context 的选择同步接口。

不包含：
高端 CAD 编辑、网格修改、完整后处理 contour 引擎、任意文件执行。
design:
优先使用浏览器友好的 glTF/GLB 或明确受支持格式；转换必须在 Go 受控子进程中进行，限制路径、大小、超时和输出目录。
Viewer 组件与 Flow360 数据获取解耦：asset manifest + group metadata 作为接口。
preview 缓存位于 VIBESIM_DATA_DIR，使用内容/资源版本键并允许安全清理。
acceptance_criteria:
- 至少一个真实 Geometry 或 Mesh 资源可以在浏览器交互显示。
- Geometry/SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh 共用 viewer 基础组件和相机控制。
- group/zone/region 可以着色、隐藏并与 Inspector 选择同步。
- 资源切换取消旧加载，不发生错配。
- 大文件显示进度并执行明确的大小/复杂度降级。
- 不支持或无 preview 时工作台其他功能仍可使用并解释原因。
- 后端拒绝路径穿越、任意本地文件和超限资产。
- 组件测试、后端安全测试与 ego-browser 视觉回归通过。
notes: Completed the real Geometry visualization path. Project sync now downloads Flow360 UVF manifest plus referenced .bin tessellation into the Go-managed .vibesim mirror using a constrained Flow360 SDK subprocess, atomic replacement, path/type/size/timeout validation, and artifact metadata. Added a reusable dependency-free-from-React Three.js library (Flow360UVFLoader + parser/builder) for indexed faces, normals, edges, LOD buffer resolution, progress, cancellation and disposal; Viewer3D retains shared glTF/GLB support and group visibility/color/selection controls. Local preview and asset APIs serve only validated cached Geometry assets. Verified production project prj-9ac04d2f-c8cc-4d26-b4c7-0295e512aa94 / geo-b358929e-0a46-4d3a-95de-ae1787bc8734 in ego-browser: flow360-uvf, WebGL true, 6 faces, 12 edges, 384 triangles, no viewer error; manifest 10,786 bytes and bin 18,720 bytes match artifact records. Validation: go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., 37 frontend tests, production build, git diff --check.
close_reason: 真实 Flow360 Geometry UVF 已完成本地同步、Three.js 渲染、安全边界、自动化测试和 ego-browser 验收。

title: 实现 Case 对比、变体与参数 Sweep
description:
问题：
用户需要回答设计决策，而不是逐个查看孤立 Case。当前 Compare 标签不可用，也没有从基准 Case 创建安全变体或 sweep 的完整体验。

范围：
- 实现 /projects/:projectId/compare 深链。
- 从同一 Project 选择两个或更多 Cases。
- 对比 SimulationParams 语义差异、状态、收敛 assessment、Cl/Cd/Cm 等 KPI。
- 从一个 Case 创建 reviewed variation。
- 批量生成参数 sweep 计划并显示 case 数、变量组合和预算风险。
- 保存 provenance：baseline、patch、created resource IDs。

不包含：
自动优化器、无限维 DOE、未经批准的批量云执行。
design: Compare 页面使用 resource IDs 作为 URL/query state。升级为有界宽度的决策工作台：选择区可折叠；Evidence/Visual/Parameters 三个证据视图；Case 卡按同一列对齐。后端聚合每个 Case 的结果文件清单、收敛与 KPI、可视化能力，并提供基于结构化证据的 AI comparison endpoint。AI 必须区分观测、推断和缺失证据，不直接执行 mutation。可视化阶段先提供同一资源视图的并排打开与同步比较入口，后续差值场依赖字段/网格兼容性。
acceptance_criteria:
- Compare URL 可恢复至少两个已选 Cases。
- 参数 diff 忽略无意义 JSON 排序，但保留单位和值变化。
- KPI 同时展示数值、单位、收敛状态与来源；未收敛 Case 不被无风险地排名为更优。
- 结果文件按路径形成跨 Case 覆盖矩阵，共有文本结果可并排预览，缺失文件明确显示。
- 至少两个真实 Case 可并排渲染可视化资产，共享字段选择与方向命令。
- 数值差值场只有在拓扑、坐标、字段、归一化和时间对齐兼容后才允许。
- AI 基于服务端重新获取的参数、收敛、KPI、结果文件和可视化证据分析差异，并区分观测、假设和缺失证据。
- 页面使用有界宽度，桌面和移动端不产生页面横向溢出。
- variation/sweep 保持审查、预算确认、幂等和远端 ID/tree 回写要求。
- Go、React 与 ego-browser 覆盖主要比较路径。
notes: Major implementation completed: restorable Compare URL, semantic SimulationParams diff, convergence-aware KPI comparison, reviewed variations and sweep. The 2026-08-12 Compare workbench now includes bounded Evidence/Visual/Result files/Parameters/Sweep views, linked Case UVF viewers, structured parameter JSON trees, and server-side evidence-based AI analysis. Result file coverage now opens a dedicated accessible comparison dialog rather than inline raw text. Tabular files overlay all selected Case datasets in the shared chart viewer, prefer a physical measurement over coordinate/progression columns, and provide an Aligned values view with selectable common columns, Case values, and candidate-minus-baseline deltas for the first 200 rows. JSON files use side-by-side JSON trees and other text safely falls back to bounded raw panes. Real X_slicing_forceDistribution.csv evidence: two 300x2 Case datasets, two chart series, default fluid/wall_Cumulative_CD_Curve selection, four-column aligned table with 200 populated deltas, 1280px dialog, and zero page/dialog overflow. Full 566-test Web suite and production build pass. Remaining before original bead closure: separately authorized variation/sweep remote lifecycle and returned resource ID/tree refresh; no billable mutation was performed.

title: 补充 appended/compressed VTK Slice 兼容性
description: 在真实归档出现 appended raw/base64 或 vtkZLibDataCompressor 数据时，为流式 VTU 转换器补齐解析和边界校验。
acceptance_criteria: 覆盖发现的 appended/compressed 变体；保持有界内存、取消和畸形输入拒绝测试。
notes: Implemented disk-streamed raw/base64 appended arrays and vtkZLibDataCompressor inline/appended decoding for UInt32/UInt64 headers. Added LittleEndian/compressor validation, 2 GiB decoded bounds, compressed block-count/size bounds, cancellation, malformed-header rejection, and five variant conversion tests.
close_reason: Appended/compressed VTK compatibility implemented and tested.

title: 实现 Surface-to-Volume 追溯与网格 QA 报告
description: 从坏体单元追溯关联 surface、surface quality、refinement 和 boundary-layer rule，并生成可签核的 VolumeMesh QA 报告。
acceptance_criteria: 问题可跨资源追溯；报告包含证据截图、阈值、结论和 Pass/Warning/Fail 状态，可导出或分享。

title: 实现 VolumeMesh 规模资源估算与版本对比
description: 展示 cell/node/face 规模、zone 占比、资源需求估算，并比较两个网格版本的规模、质量、refinement 和 boundary-layer 差异。
acceptance_criteria: 资源估算标注模型和假设；版本对比可追溯字段来源并支持空间差异定位。

title: Add exact and asynchronous Geometry diagnostics backend
description: Extend the bounded UVF evidence diagnostics with asynchronous jobs for large Geometry resources, persistent result caching, normal/curvature statistics at multiple tolerances, and exact CAD-kernel or spatial-index clearance when Flow360 exposes suitable topology or geometry APIs.
design: Preserve the existing provenance contract. Exact CAD results must be distinguished from tessellation and AABB proxies. Jobs are keyed by Geometry version, asset fingerprint, algorithm version, and tolerance settings.
acceptance_criteria: Large diagnostics run asynchronously with progress and cancellation; results survive restart; exact and proxy clearance results cannot be confused; unsupported Flow360 evidence remains explicit.
close_reason: Implemented persistent asynchronous Geometry diagnostics jobs with progress, cancellation, bounded concurrency, restart-safe results/cache, and explicit exact-CAD-unavailable evidence separation.

title: Add P2 advanced Geometry diagnostics and version comparison
description: Add small-feature, gap, curvature and proximity analysis, semi-automatic grouping, repair recommendations, Geometry version comparison, and domain-specific review templates for aircraft, automotive, rotating machinery and thermal workflows.
design: Requires a typed Geometry diagnostics payload and provenance. Keep compute-heavy analysis asynchronous and cache results by Geometry version and tolerance settings.
acceptance_criteria: Advanced diagnostics use server-backed evidence, can focus affected entities, compare geometry versions, and generate reviewable repair or grouping proposals without inventing unsupported results.
notes: Completed: typed server evidence; Flow360 face-area small-feature detection; AABB gap/proximity lower-bound proxy; indexed normal-buffer curvature proxy; inferred body grouping; version comparison; domain templates; 3D focus; review-plan evidence; bounded in-memory cache keyed by resource, manifest, and thresholds. Exact CAD clearance, persistent async jobs, and restart-safe caching are tracked in flow360-cli-cs3.
close_reason: Completed server-backed small-feature, AABB gap/proximity, tessellation-normal curvature diagnostics, version comparison, inferred grouping, domain templates, 3D focus, evidence plans, and bounded fingerprint caching. Exact CAD/asynchronous enhancements continue in flow360-cli-cs3.

title: 补全非核心 Flow360 CLI 管理能力
description: 核心 Vibe Flow360 端到端闭环完成后，按需补齐尚未封装的 CLI 管理能力：Draft info/state/simulation-params get/set/patch，project path/search/pagination/rename/delete，folder create/get/rename/move/delete，Geometry/SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh/Case rename/delete，logs head/all/save，open。login/logout/configure 保持低优先级并单独评估凭据安全边界。本事项不得抢占 flow360-cli-lf5 核心闭环。
acceptance_criteria: 核心 Epic 已通过端到端 Gate；每个写操作具备 typed endpoint、目标预览、明确确认、审计记录和执行后读取验证；删除和凭据操作不得通过通用命令执行器暴露。
notes: 优先级约束：仅在 flow360-cli-lf5 核心端到端 Epic 通过发布验收 Gate 后再开始；当前保持 P3 backlog。

value: VibeSim 的核心产品原则是 agent-first 的 Vibe Simulate，而不是带 Chat 的传统 CFD 表单。任何 preflight、meshing、solver、convergence 或远程执行异常都应自动进入 agent intervention：读取 Project/资源/SimulationParams/schema/logs 上下文，形成原因假设与可审查修复 plan；根据用户自然语言意见自动调整参数并反复 validate，直到通过或明确需要工程决策。低风险本地草案和校验可自动执行；审批、付费云资源和不可逆远程操作必须保留明确用户确认。UI 应以对话、建议、diff、证据和恢复进度为主，动态表单只是 agent 请求结构化信息的工具，不能成为主要工作流。

Vibe Flow360 Web 多语言开发约束（2026-08-07）：后续所有新增或修改的用户可见 Web 内容都必须接入 i18n，不允许直接依赖硬编码英文或中英文混排。范围包括标题、正文、按钮、菜单、占位符、Tooltip、空状态、加载/进度/完成状态、错误与警告、表单校验、动态数量和带变量句子，以及 aria-label、title、alt 等无障碍文本。动态文案必须以完整句子调用 useI18n().t，避免把变量与可翻译碎片拆开。新增文案必须同步补充当前支持语言（至少 en 与 zh-CN）的语言包或明确的英文源语言回退，并为关键功能域增加翻译覆盖测试。接口返回的用户提示优先采用稳定 code + params 后由前端翻译；未知后端原文可作为 fallback，技术日志可保留原文。功能验收需在英文和中文界面检查，不得只验证默认语言。

资源页面架构原则（2026-08-02，2026-08-06补充）：manifest.json + bin/UVF 是业务无关的通用可视化协议，只负责实体层级、几何 buffer、字段、bounds、LOD、transform；Geometry/SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh/Case 的 CFD 含义由资源 capability/adapter 层解释，禁止把 boundary、cell zone、residual 等业务判断写入通用渲染库。共享能力包括层级/搜索/显示隐藏/隔离/选择、相机、clip、measure、wire、字段着色/Linear-Log/范围/probe、通用 field 范围谓词的 AND/OR 组合与命中三角形线框叠加、截图、加载错误与版本比较框架。质量字段分类、风险方向和按资源保存筛选会话属于 SurfaceMesh capability/hook，不进入 UVF 库。Geometry 特有 CAD topology/material/health/semantic assignment；SurfaceMesh 特有 boundary assignment、surface parameters、face quality/worst-region、Plan VolumeMesh；VolumeMesh 特有 cell zones/domain/layers、slice、volume quality、Plan Case；Case 特有 solver lifecycle、convergence/residual/forces/monitors/logs/result fields/restart/variation。Panel 只放当前上下文、可扫读、高频、可逆且影响 3D 的数据和控件；弹窗/抽屉用于完整参数树、raw manifest、跨版本大 diff、长日志/统计、多步骤 AI remediation，以及付费/远程/不可逆/需审批动作。无真实数据的指标不渲染，正常成功状态不重复，只有 actionable exception 才额外提示。

3D 交互产品要求（2026-08-13）：Geometry、SurfaceMesh、VolumeMesh、Case、Compare、Slice 等所有共享 3D 视图必须将丝滑操作作为统一验收标准，而非逐页面调参。目标以交互期间 60fps/16.7ms 帧预算为主；旋转采用鼠标下表面动态枢轴而非长期固定中心；旋转、平移、缩放、选择、悬停、探测、控制点拖拽、线框、裁剪、字段范围、质量筛选、LIC 和双视口同步均需独立性能验收。架构优先按需渲染、自适应 DPR、BVH/first-hit 拾取、每帧事件合并、GPU/Worker 重计算，避免每帧 React 状态同步与全场景遍历。

产品优先级决策（2026-07-31）：暂不追求完整封装 Flow360 CLI。第一优先级是跑通 Vibe Flow360 核心闭环：Project/资源浏览与同步 → 从 Geometry/SurfaceMesh/VolumeMesh 选择 Run up to → 动态展示各阶段必需参数 → Agent 补全或修复 → 本地 preflight 验证 → 用户审查批准 → draft run → 远端状态监控 → 结果/日志/收敛查看与失败恢复。后续再补 CLI 管理能力，包括 Draft info/state/simulation-params get/set/patch、project path/search/pagination/rename/delete、folder create/get/rename/move/delete、资源 rename/delete、logs head/all/save、open，以及可选的登录配置。账号凭据操作继续低优先级并保持安全边界。

Project 页面 UI 信息密度、Tooltip 与视觉层级原则（2026-08-07，2026-08-08补充）：Project 主页面信息较多，应尽量保持简洁。非必要常驻的详细信息优先只保留 icon、按钮或一行文字入口，点击后通过弹窗或抽屉展示；帮助性、解释性、原理性、限制性信息默认使用帮助 icon + Tooltip，不在主界面重复铺开或反复强调。Tooltip 不是只能放一段文字：根据内容可使用标题、简短摘要、分组标签、要点列表、键值/步骤、数据来源、适用范围与限制等结构化层级，但仍应简洁且不可承载主要操作或必须即时看到的异常。鼠标 hover、键盘 focus（触屏可点击聚焦）时展示。帮助入口视觉上必须弱于标题、状态与主操作：默认使用小尺寸、中性低对比图标、透明背景，不使用品牌主色填充、强调色块或与主操作相同的容器样式；只有 hover/focus 时轻微增强。核心、高频、必须即时可见、异常且可行动的信息仍应直接显示，不能藏进 Tooltip。Tooltip 触发器必须有可理解的无障碍名称，提示内容使用 role=tooltip 并与触发器关联。组件组合时必须使用明确 class，避免父级通配/结构选择器误伤 Tooltip 等嵌套组件；UI 变更需在真实组合页面检查视觉层级。

Flow360 Draft entities referenced through EntityList.stored_entities (for example Sphere, Box, Cylinder, Slice) must also be owned by private_attribute_asset_cache.project_entity_info.draft_entities with matching IDs. The Python Project/DraftContext submission path performs this merge, but raw 'draft simulation-params set' does not. Configured Draft creation must preserve canonical remote Geometry entity metadata, merge only draft_entities, and reject dangling references during preflight and before save.
